```{r setup_helpers, echo=TRUE}
# Helper functions
draw_close_parameters <- function(center, rel_sd = 1e-5, abs_sd = 1e-6) {
  center <- as.numeric(center)
  if (length(center) == 0L || any(!is.finite(center))) return(center)

  had_seed <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  if (had_seed) old_seed <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)

  seed_value <- as.integer((sum(abs(center) * 1e6) + 104729 * length(center)) %% 2147483000)
  if (!is.finite(seed_value) || seed_value <= 0L) seed_value <- 104729L
  set.seed(seed_value)

  sd_vec <- pmax(abs(center) * rel_sd, abs_sd)
  out <- rnorm(length(center), mean = center, sd = sd_vec)

  if (had_seed) {
    assign(".Random.seed", old_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  } else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
    rm(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  out
}


local_rnorm <- function(n, mean, sd, seed, lower = -Inf, upper = Inf) {
  had_seed <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  if (had_seed) old_seed <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  set.seed(as.integer(seed))
  out <- rnorm(n, mean = mean, sd = sd)
  out <- pmin(pmax(out, lower), upper)
  if (had_seed) {
    assign(".Random.seed", old_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  } else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
    rm(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  out
}

draw_normal_trend <- function(n, start, end, sd, seed,
                              lower = -Inf, upper = Inf) {
  mu <- seq(start, end, length.out = n)
  local_rnorm(n, mean = mu, sd = sd, seed = seed,
              lower = lower, upper = upper)
}

draw_normal_level <- function(n, mean, sd, seed,
                              lower = -Inf, upper = Inf) {
  local_rnorm(n, mean = rep(mean, n), sd = sd, seed = seed,
              lower = lower, upper = upper)
}

draw_control_value <- function(mean, sd, seed,
                               lower = -Inf, upper = Inf) {
  local_rnorm(1L, mean = mean, sd = sd, seed = seed,
              lower = lower, upper = upper)[1]
}

local_runif <- function(n, min, max, seed) {
  had_seed <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  if (had_seed) old_seed <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  set.seed(as.integer(seed))
  out <- runif(n, min = min, max = max)
  if (had_seed) {
    assign(".Random.seed", old_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  } else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
    rm(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  out
}

draw_uniform_range <- function(n, min, max, seed, decreasing = FALSE) {
  sort(local_runif(n, min, max, seed), decreasing = decreasing)
}

draw_uniform_value <- function(min, max, seed) {
  local_runif(1L, min, max, seed)[1]
}

generate_gl20 <- function() {
  n <- 20L

  legendre_pair <- function(n, x) {
    p0 <- rep(1, length(x))
    if (n == 0L) return(list(pn = p0, pnm1 = rep(0, length(x))))
    p1 <- x
    if (n == 1L) return(list(pn = p1, pnm1 = p0))
    for (k in 2:n) {
      pk <- ((2 * k - 1) * x * p1 - (k - 1) * p0) / k
      p0 <- p1
      p1 <- pk
    }
    list(pn = p1, pnm1 = p0)
  }

  k <- seq_len(n)
  x <- cos(pi * (4 * k - 1) / (4 * n + 2))
  for (iter in 1:8) {
    pp <- legendre_pair(n, x)
    dp <- n * (x * pp$pn - pp$pnm1) / (x^2 - 1)
    x <- x - pp$pn / dp
  }
  x <- sort(x)
  pp <- legendre_pair(n, x)
  dp <- n * (x * pp$pn - pp$pnm1) / (x^2 - 1)
  w <- 2 / ((1 - x^2) * dp^2)

  x <- local_rnorm(n, mean = x, sd = 1e-12, seed = 91021,
                   lower = -1 + 1e-12, upper = 1 - 1e-12)
  x <- sort(x)
  w <- local_rnorm(n, mean = w, sd = 1e-12, seed = 91022,
                   lower = .Machine$double.eps, upper = Inf)
  w <- 2 * w / sum(w)

  list(x = x, w = w)
}
```

```{r, error=TRUE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(openxlsx)
  library(survival)
  library(stats)
  library(dplyr)
  library(gsDesign)
  library(flexsurv)
})

compiler::enableJIT(3)

Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
  NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS = "1"
)

set.seed(1234567)

FIXED_FOLLOWUP <- 5

apply_calendar_end <- function(df, L) {
  out <- df[df$rec_time <= L, , drop = FALSE]
  out$time <- pmin(out$study_time, L) - out$rec_time
  out$cens <- as.integer(out$study_time <= L)
  out
}


apply_fixed_followup <- function(df, fixed_followup) {
  out <- df
  out$cens <- as.integer(out$event_time <= fixed_followup)
  out$time <- pmin(out$event_time, fixed_followup)
  out$time[out$time < 0] <- 0
  out
}

stage2_logrank_fixed_followup <- function(final_pool, interim_time, fixed_followup) {
  event_cal  <- final_pool$study_time
  censor_cal <- final_pool$rec_time + fixed_followup
  exit_cal   <- pmin(event_cal, censor_cal)
  event_obs  <- as.integer(final_pool$event_time <= fixed_followup)

  stage2_event_times <- sort(unique(
    event_cal[event_obs == 1L & event_cal > interim_time]
  ))

  if (length(stage2_event_times) == 0L) {
    return(list(U2 = 0, I2 = 0))
  }

  U2 <- 0
  I2 <- 0

  for (tt in stage2_event_times) {
    at_risk <- final_pool$rec_time <= tt & exit_cal >= tt

    Y1 <- sum(at_risk & final_pool$group == 1)
    Y2 <- sum(at_risk & final_pool$group == 2)
    Y  <- Y1 + Y2

    is_event <- event_obs == 1L & event_cal == tt
    d1 <- sum(is_event & final_pool$group == 1)
    d2 <- sum(is_event & final_pool$group == 2)
    d  <- d1 + d2

    if (Y > 1 && d > 0) {
      U2 <- U2 + d2 - d * Y2 / Y
      I2 <- I2 + (Y1 * Y2 * d * (Y - d)) / (Y^2 * (Y - 1))
    }
  }

  list(U2 = U2, I2 = I2)
}

make_gs_design <- function(d_half, d, alpha_one_sided, beta) {
  gsDesign(
    k = 2,
    test.type = 1,
    alpha = alpha_one_sided,
    beta = beta,
    n.I = c(d_half, d),
    sfu = sfPoints,
    sfupar = c(0, 1),
    delta0 = 0,
    delta1 = 1
  )
}

gs_cond_power <- function(z1_gs, D_total, x_gs, theta = NULL) {
  n2 <- D_total - x_gs$n.I[1]
  if (!is.finite(z1_gs) || !is.finite(n2) || n2 <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  as.numeric(condPower(
    z1 = z1_gs,
    n2 = n2,
    z2 = z2NC,
    theta = theta,
    x = x_gs
  ))
}

find_D_for_target_cp_gs <- function(target_cp, z1_gs, x_gs, D_min, D_max,
                                    theta = NULL) {
  cp_min <- gs_cond_power(z1_gs, D_min, x_gs, theta)
  if (is.finite(cp_min) && cp_min >= target_cp) return(D_min)

  cp_max <- gs_cond_power(z1_gs, D_max, x_gs, theta)
  if (!is.finite(cp_max) || cp_max < target_cp) return(D_max)

  f <- function(D) gs_cond_power(z1_gs, D, x_gs, theta) - target_cp
  uniroot(f, lower = D_min, upper = D_max)$root
}


logrank_theta_from_survival <- function(S_control, S_treatment, t_max,
                                        n_grid = 100L) {
  if (is.null(S_control) || !is.function(S_control) ||
      is.null(S_treatment) || !is.function(S_treatment) ||
      !is.finite(t_max) || t_max <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  tt <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = as.integer(n_grid) + 1L)

  S1 <- tryCatch(as.numeric(S_control(tt)), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(tt)))
  S2 <- tryCatch(as.numeric(S_treatment(tt)), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(tt)))

  if (length(S1) != length(tt) || length(S2) != length(tt) ||
      any(!is.finite(S1)) || any(!is.finite(S2))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  S1 <- cummin(pmin(pmax(S1, 0), 1))
  S2 <- cummin(pmin(pmax(S2, 0), 1))

  Y1 <- S1[-length(S1)]
  Y2 <- S2[-length(S2)]

  dN1 <- pmax(S1[-length(S1)] - S1[-1], 0)
  dN2 <- pmax(S2[-length(S2)] - S2[-1], 0)
  dN  <- dN1 + dN2

  Ytot <- Y1 + Y2
  ok <- is.finite(Ytot) & (Ytot > 1e-12) &
        is.finite(dN) & (dN >= 0)

  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)

  Y1 <- Y1[ok]
  Y2 <- Y2[ok]
  dN1 <- dN1[ok]
  dN2 <- dN2[ok]
  dN <- dN[ok]
  Ytot <- Ytot[ok]

  U_trt <- sum(dN2 - (Y2 / Ytot) * dN)

  V_lr <- sum((Y1 * Y2 / (Ytot^2)) * dN)
  D_lr <- sum(dN)

  if (!is.finite(U_trt) || !is.finite(V_lr) || !is.finite(D_lr) ||
      V_lr <= 0 || D_lr <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  theta_lr <- (-U_trt) / sqrt(V_lr * D_lr)

  if (!is.finite(theta_lr)) NA_real_ else theta_lr
}


analytic_chw_cp_vector <- function(target_events, interim_events,
                                   z1_gs, x_gs, theta_logrank) {
  target_events <- as.numeric(target_events)
  nout <- length(target_events)

  zcrit2 <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(z2NC(z1 = z1_gs, x = x_gs)),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  D2 <- target_events - interim_events
  mu_z2 <- rep(NA_real_, nout)
  cp <- rep(NA_real_, nout)

  ok <- is.finite(target_events) & is.finite(D2) & (D2 > 0) &
        is.finite(theta_logrank) & is.finite(zcrit2)

  if (any(ok)) {
    mu_z2[ok] <- theta_logrank * sqrt(D2[ok])
    cp[ok] <- pnorm(mu_z2[ok] - zcrit2)
  }

  data.frame(
    target_events = target_events,
    D2 = D2,
    mu_z2 = mu_z2,
    cp = cp
  )
}

S_pieceweib <- function(t, shape_pre, scale_pre, shape_post, scale_post, c) {
  t <- pmax(t, 0)
  c <- pmax(c, 0)

  if (c <= 0) {
    return(exp(- (t / scale_post)^shape_post))
  }

  H1c <- (c / scale_pre)^shape_pre
  out <- numeric(length(t))

  idx1 <- t <= c
  idx2 <- !idx1

  if (any(idx1)) {
    out[idx1] <- exp(- (t[idx1] / scale_pre)^shape_pre)
  }
  if (any(idx2)) {
    out[idx2] <- exp(- (H1c + ((t[idx2] - c) / scale_post)^shape_post))
  }

  out
}

kth_event_cut <- function(study_times, k) {
  if (!is.finite(k) || k < 1) return(NA_real_)
  kk <- ceiling(k)
  st <- study_times[is.finite(study_times)]
  if (length(st) < kk) return(NA_real_)
  sort(st, partial = kk)[kk]
}


mst_from_S <- function(S_fun, t_max, n_grid = 300) {
  if (is.null(S_fun) || !is.function(S_fun) || !is.finite(t_max) || t_max <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  t_grid <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = n_grid)
  S_vals <- tryCatch(as.numeric(S_fun(t_grid)), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(t_grid)))
  if (length(S_vals) != length(t_grid) || any(!is.finite(S_vals)) ||
      any(S_vals < -1e-8) || any(S_vals > 1 + 1e-8) ||
      any(diff(S_vals) > 1e-8)) return(NA_real_)
  S_vals <- pmin(pmax(S_vals, 0), 1)
  sum(diff(t_grid) * head(S_vals, -1))
}


rmst_from_S <- function(S_fun, tau, n_grid = 300) {
  if (is.null(S_fun) || !is.function(S_fun) || !is.finite(tau) || tau <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  t_grid <- seq(0, tau, length.out = n_grid)
  S_vals <- tryCatch(as.numeric(S_fun(t_grid)), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(t_grid)))
  if (length(S_vals) != length(t_grid) || any(!is.finite(S_vals)) ||
      any(S_vals < -1e-8) || any(S_vals > 1 + 1e-8) ||
      any(diff(S_vals) > 1e-8)) return(NA_real_)
  S_vals <- pmin(pmax(S_vals, 0), 1)
  sum(diff(t_grid) * head(S_vals, -1))
}


strict_flexsurv_fit <- function(time_vec, cens_vec, dist_name) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      flexsurvreg(Surv(time_vec, cens_vec) ~ 1, dist = dist_name),
      warning = function(w) {
        warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit) || length(warnings_seen) > 0) return(NULL)

  conv <- tryCatch(fit$opt$convergence, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(conv) && length(conv) > 0 && any(conv != 0)) return(NULL)

  cf <- tryCatch(coef(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(cf) || any(!is.finite(cf))) return(NULL)

  V <- tryCatch(vcov(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(V) || any(!is.finite(V))) return(NULL)

  fit
}

valid_survival_function <- function(S_fun, t_max, n_grid = 50L, tol = 1e-8) {
  if (is.null(S_fun) || !is.function(S_fun) || !is.finite(t_max) || t_max <= 0) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  tt <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = n_grid)
  ss <- tryCatch(as.numeric(S_fun(tt)), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(tt)))
  if (length(ss) != length(tt) || any(!is.finite(ss))) return(FALSE)
  if (any(ss < -tol) || any(ss > 1 + tol)) return(FALSE)
  if (any(diff(ss) > tol)) return(FALSE)
  TRUE
}

make_fast_km_survival <- function(km_fit) {
  km_time <- as.numeric(km_fit$time)
  km_surv <- as.numeric(km_fit$surv)

  if (length(km_time) > 0L) {
    prev_time <- c(0, head(km_time, -1L))
    prev_surv <- c(1, head(km_surv, -1L))
    area_at_time <- cumsum((km_time - prev_time) * prev_surv)
  } else {
    area_at_time <- numeric(0)
  }

  km_area <- function(t) {
    t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(t))
    ok <- is.finite(t)

    if (any(ok)) {
      x <- t[ok]
      if (length(km_time) == 0L) {
        vals <- x
      } else {
        idx <- findInterval(x, km_time)
        vals <- numeric(length(x))

        before_first <- idx == 0L
        if (any(before_first)) {
          vals[before_first] <- x[before_first]
        }

        after_some <- !before_first
        if (any(after_some)) {
          j <- idx[after_some]
          vals[after_some] <-
            area_at_time[j] +
            (x[after_some] - km_time[j]) * km_surv[j]
        }
      }
      out[ok] <- vals
    }
    out
  }

  km_fun <- function(t) {
    t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(t))
    ok <- is.finite(t)
    if (any(ok)) {
      idx <- findInterval(t[ok], km_time)
      vals <- rep(1, sum(ok))
      pos <- idx > 0L
      if (any(pos)) vals[pos] <- km_surv[idx[pos]]
      out[ok] <- vals
    }
    out <- pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
    out[t == 0] <- 1
    out
  }

  attr(km_fun, "cum_surv_area") <- km_area
  km_fun
}

fast_gl20_surv_area <- local({
  gl20_local <- generate_gl20()
  gl20_x_local <- gl20_local$x
  gl20_w_local <- gl20_local$w
  rm(gl20_local)

  function(S_fun, t) {
    t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(t))
    ok <- is.finite(t)

    if (!any(ok)) return(out)

    xout <- t[ok]
    vals <- numeric(length(xout))
    positive <- xout > 0

    if (any(positive)) {
      tp <- xout[positive]
      vals_pos <- vapply(
        tp,
        function(upper) {
          mid <- upper / 2
          xx <- mid * (gl20_x_local + 1)
          ss <- S_fun(xx)
          if (length(ss) != length(xx) || any(!is.finite(ss))) return(NA_real_)
          mid * sum(gl20_w_local * ss)
        },
        numeric(1)
      )
      vals[positive] <- vals_pos
    }

    out[ok] <- vals
    out
  }
})
make_fast_parametric_survival <- function(param_fit, extrap_dist) {
  extrap_dist <- tolower(extrap_dist)

  pars <- tryCatch({
    rr <- param_fit$res
    if (is.null(rr) || is.null(rownames(rr)) || !("est" %in% colnames(rr))) NULL
    else stats::setNames(as.numeric(rr[, "est"]), rownames(rr))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  original_predictor <- function(t) {
    t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
    out <- tryCatch(
      summary(param_fit, t = pmax(t, 1e-8), type = "survival", ci = FALSE)[[1]]$est,
      error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(t))
    )
    out <- as.numeric(out)
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
    out <- pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
    out[t == 0] <- 1
    out
  }

  if (is.null(pars)) {
    area_fun <- function(t) fast_gl20_surv_area(original_predictor, t)
    attr(original_predictor, "cum_surv_area") <- area_fun
    return(original_predictor)
  }

  predictor <- switch(
    extrap_dist,
    exponential = if ("rate" %in% names(pars)) {
      rate <- unname(pars["rate"])
      function(t) stats::pexp(pmax(as.numeric(t), 0), rate = rate, lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else NULL,
    weibull = if (all(c("shape", "scale") %in% names(pars))) {
      shape <- unname(pars["shape"]); scale <- unname(pars["scale"])
      function(t) stats::pweibull(pmax(as.numeric(t), 0), shape = shape, scale = scale,
                                  lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else NULL,
    gamma = if (all(c("shape", "rate") %in% names(pars))) {
      shape <- unname(pars["shape"]); rate <- unname(pars["rate"])
      function(t) stats::pgamma(pmax(as.numeric(t), 0), shape = shape, rate = rate,
                                lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else NULL,
    loglogistic = if (all(c("shape", "scale") %in% names(pars))) {
      shape <- unname(pars["shape"]); scale <- unname(pars["scale"])
      function(t) flexsurv::pllogis(pmax(as.numeric(t), 0), shape = shape, scale = scale,
                                    lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else NULL,
    lognormal = if (all(c("meanlog", "sdlog") %in% names(pars))) {
      meanlog <- unname(pars["meanlog"]); sdlog <- unname(pars["sdlog"])
      function(t) stats::plnorm(pmax(as.numeric(t), 0), meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog,
                                lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else NULL,
    NULL
  )

  if (is.null(predictor)) {
    area_fun <- function(t) fast_gl20_surv_area(original_predictor, t)
    attr(original_predictor, "cum_surv_area") <- area_fun
    return(original_predictor)
  }

  fast_predictor <- function(t) {
    t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
    out <- tryCatch(predictor(t), error = function(e) original_predictor(t))
    out <- as.numeric(out)
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
    out <- pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
    out[t == 0] <- 1
    out
  }

  area_fun <- switch(
    extrap_dist,
    exponential = if ("rate" %in% names(pars)) {
      rate <- unname(pars["rate"])
      function(t) {
        t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
        if (!is.finite(rate) || rate <= 0) return(fast_gl20_surv_area(fast_predictor, t))
        -expm1(-rate * t) / rate
      }
    } else NULL,

    weibull = if (all(c("shape", "scale") %in% names(pars))) {
      shape <- unname(pars["shape"]); scale <- unname(pars["scale"])
      function(t) {
        t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
        if (!is.finite(shape) || shape <= 0 || !is.finite(scale) || scale <= 0) {
          return(fast_gl20_surv_area(fast_predictor, t))
        }
        z <- (t / scale)^shape
        (scale / shape) * gamma(1 / shape) *
          stats::pgamma(z, shape = 1 / shape, rate = 1)
      }
    } else NULL,

    gamma = if (all(c("shape", "rate") %in% names(pars))) {
      shape <- unname(pars["shape"]); rate <- unname(pars["rate"])
      function(t) {
        t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
        if (!is.finite(shape) || shape <= 0 || !is.finite(rate) || rate <= 0) {
          return(fast_gl20_surv_area(fast_predictor, t))
        }
        (shape / rate) *
          stats::pgamma(t, shape = shape + 1, rate = rate) +
          t * stats::pgamma(t, shape = shape, rate = rate, lower.tail = FALSE)
      }
    } else NULL,

    lognormal = if (all(c("meanlog", "sdlog") %in% names(pars))) {
      meanlog <- unname(pars["meanlog"]); sdlog <- unname(pars["sdlog"])
      function(t) {
        t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
        if (!is.finite(meanlog) || !is.finite(sdlog) || sdlog <= 0) {
          return(fast_gl20_surv_area(fast_predictor, t))
        }
        out <- numeric(length(t))
        pos <- t > 0
        if (any(pos)) {
          tp <- t[pos]
          z1 <- (log(tp) - meanlog - sdlog^2) / sdlog
          trunc_mean <- exp(meanlog + 0.5 * sdlog^2) * stats::pnorm(z1)
          surv <- stats::plnorm(
            tp, meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog, lower.tail = FALSE
          )
          out[pos] <- trunc_mean + tp * surv
        }
        out
      }
    } else NULL,

    loglogistic = function(t) fast_gl20_surv_area(fast_predictor, t),
    NULL
  )

  if (is.null(area_fun)) {
    area_fun <- function(t) fast_gl20_surv_area(fast_predictor, t)
  }

  attr(fast_predictor, "cum_surv_area") <- area_fun
  fast_predictor
}

make_hybrid_km_parametric <- function(time_vec, cens_vec, extrap_dist) {
  time_vec <- pmax(as.numeric(time_vec), 1e-8)
  cens_vec <- as.integer(cens_vec)

  supported_dists <- c(
    exponential = "exp",
    weibull = "weibull",
    gamma = "gamma",
    loglogistic = "llogis",
    lognormal = "lnorm"
  )

  extrap_dist <- tolower(extrap_dist)
  if (!extrap_dist %in% names(supported_dists)) {
    stop(
      "Unsupported extrapolation distribution: ", extrap_dist,
      ". Choose exponential, weibull, gamma, loglogistic, or lognormal."
    )
  }

  if (!length(time_vec) || length(time_vec) != length(cens_vec)) return(NULL)

  km_fit <- tryCatch(
    survfit(Surv(time_vec, cens_vec) ~ 1),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  param_fit <- strict_flexsurv_fit(
    time_vec = time_vec,
    cens_vec = cens_vec,
    dist_name = unname(supported_dists[extrap_dist])
  )

  if (is.null(km_fit) || is.null(param_fit)) return(NULL)

  splice_time <- max(time_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(splice_time) || splice_time <= 0) return(NULL)

  km_survival <- make_fast_km_survival(km_fit)
  km_area <- attr(km_survival, "cum_surv_area", exact = TRUE)

  param_survival <- make_fast_parametric_survival(param_fit, extrap_dist)
  param_area <- attr(param_survival, "cum_surv_area", exact = TRUE)

  S_km_splice <- km_survival(splice_time)
  S_par_splice <- param_survival(splice_time)

  if (!is.finite(S_km_splice) || !is.finite(S_par_splice) ||
      S_par_splice <= 0 || !is.function(km_area) ||
      !is.function(param_area)) return(NULL)

  tail_scale <- S_km_splice / S_par_splice
  A_km_splice <- km_area(splice_time)
  A_par_splice <- param_area(splice_time)

  if (!is.finite(A_km_splice) || !is.finite(A_par_splice)) return(NULL)

  hybrid_fun <- function(t) {
    t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(t))

    idx_km <- t <= splice_time
    if (any(idx_km)) {
      out[idx_km] <- km_survival(t[idx_km])
    }

    idx_tail <- !idx_km
    if (any(idx_tail)) {
      out[idx_tail] <- tail_scale * param_survival(t[idx_tail])
    }

    out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
    out <- pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
    out[t == 0] <- 1
    out
  }

  hybrid_area <- function(t) {
    t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(t))
    ok <- is.finite(t)

    if (any(ok)) {
      x <- t[ok]
      vals <- numeric(length(x))

      idx_km <- x <= splice_time
      if (any(idx_km)) {
        vals[idx_km] <- km_area(x[idx_km])
      }

      idx_tail <- !idx_km
      if (any(idx_tail)) {
        vals[idx_tail] <-
          A_km_splice +
          tail_scale * (param_area(x[idx_tail]) - A_par_splice)
      }

      out[ok] <- vals
    }
    out
  }

  attr(hybrid_fun, "cum_surv_area") <- hybrid_area
  attr(hybrid_fun, "splice_time") <- splice_time
  attr(hybrid_fun, "distribution") <- extrap_dist
  hybrid_fun
}

get_arm_event_prob_future_hybrid <- function(arm_df, L_end, S_fun) {
  if (is.null(S_fun) || !is.function(S_fun)) return(NA_real_)

  eps <- 1e-12
  t_obs <- pmax(arm_df$time, 0)
  t_end <- pmax(L_end - arm_df$rec_time, 0)
  t_end <- pmax(t_end, t_obs)

  n_arm <- length(t_obs)
  ss <- S_fun(c(t_obs, t_end))
  if (length(ss) != 2L * n_arm) return(NA_real_)

  S_obs <- ss[seq_len(n_arm)]
  S_end <- ss[n_arm + seq_len(n_arm)]

  S_obs <- pmin(pmax(S_obs, eps), 1)
  S_end <- pmin(pmax(S_end, eps), 1)

  p_j <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(arm_df))
  is_event <- arm_df$cens == 1
  p_j[is_event] <- 1

  is_cens <- !is_event
  if (any(is_cens)) {
    p_j[is_cens] <- 1 - S_end[is_cens] / S_obs[is_cens]
  }

  p_j[!is.finite(p_j)] <- NA_real_
  p_j <- pmin(pmax(p_j, 0), 1)

  if (all(is.na(p_j))) return(NA_real_)
  mean(p_j, na.rm = TRUE)
}

true_mst_pieceweib <- function(shape_pre, scale_pre, shape_post, scale_post, c) {
  c <- pmax(c, 0)
  if (c <= 0) {
    return(scale_post * gamma(1 + 1/shape_post))
  }

  H1c <- (c / scale_pre)^shape_pre
  k   <- 1 / shape_pre

  int1 <- (scale_pre / shape_pre) * gamma(k) * pgamma(H1c, shape = k, rate = 1)

  int2 <- exp(-H1c) * scale_post * gamma(1 + 1/shape_post)

  int1 + int2
}

clamp <- function(x, lo, hi) {
  pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
}


validate_piecewise_weibull_label <- function(pattern, pars,
                                              change_point = 1,
                                              horizon = 5,
                                              tol = 1e-6) {
  if (!pattern %in% c("crossing", "diverging", "PH", "diminishing")) {
    return(invisible(TRUE))
  }

  req <- c("c_shape_pre", "c_shape_post", "c_scale_pre", "c_scale_post",
           "t_shape_pre", "t_shape_post", "t_scale_pre", "t_scale_post")
  if (!all(req %in% names(pars))) {
    stop("Piecewise-Weibull label validation: missing parameter(s): ",
         paste(setdiff(req, names(pars)), collapse = ", "))
  }
  pv <- unlist(pars[req], use.names = FALSE)
  if (any(!is.finite(pv)) || any(pv <= 0)) {
    stop("Piecewise-Weibull label validation: all shape/scale parameters must be positive and finite.")
  }

  pre_t  <- seq(max(1e-4, 0.05 * change_point),
                max(2e-4, 0.95 * change_point), length.out = 200)
  post_u <- seq(max(1e-4, 0.02 * (horizon - change_point)),
                max(2e-4, 0.98 * (horizon - change_point)), length.out = 300)

  weib_h <- function(x, shape, scale) {
    (shape / scale) * (x / scale)^(shape - 1)
  }

  hr_pre <- weib_h(pre_t, pars$t_shape_pre, pars$t_scale_pre) /
            weib_h(pre_t, pars$c_shape_pre, pars$c_scale_pre)
  hr_post <- weib_h(post_u, pars$t_shape_post, pars$t_scale_post) /
             weib_h(post_u, pars$c_shape_post, pars$c_scale_post)

  if (any(!is.finite(hr_pre)) || any(!is.finite(hr_post))) {
    stop("Piecewise-Weibull label validation produced non-finite true hazard ratios for ", pattern, ".")
  }

  hr_pre_mid  <- exp(median(log(hr_pre)))
  hr_post_mid <- exp(median(log(hr_post)))

  ok <- switch(
    pattern,
    crossing = (hr_pre_mid > 1 + tol && hr_post_mid < 1 - tol),
    diverging = (hr_pre_mid < 1 - tol && hr_post_mid < hr_pre_mid - tol),
    PH = {
      all_hr <- c(hr_pre, hr_post)
      max(abs(log(all_hr) - mean(log(all_hr)))) < 1e-5
    },
    diminishing = (hr_pre_mid < 1 - tol && hr_post_mid < 1 - tol &&
                   hr_post_mid > hr_pre_mid + tol)
  )

  if (pattern == "crossing" && ok) {
    tt <- seq(1e-4, horizon, length.out = 2000)
    Sc <- S_pieceweib(tt,
      pars$c_shape_pre, pars$c_scale_pre,
      pars$c_shape_post, pars$c_scale_post, change_point)
    St <- S_pieceweib(tt,
      pars$t_shape_pre, pars$t_scale_pre,
      pars$t_shape_post, pars$t_scale_post, change_point)
    dd <- St - Sc
    ok <- any(dd < -tol) && any(dd > tol)
  }

  if (!ok) {
    stop(
      "Piecewise-Weibull DGM label check FAILED for '", pattern, "'. ",
      "Representative true HR_pre=", signif(hr_pre_mid, 5),
      ", HR_post=", signif(hr_post_mid, 5),
      if (pattern == "crossing") "; true survival curves did not satisfy the required crossing pattern within follow-up." else ".",
      " Check the final post-calibration treatment parameters before running simulations."
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

rweibull_piecewise <- function(n,
                               shape_pre, scale_pre,
                               shape_post, scale_post,
                               c) {
  if (c <= 0) {
    return(rweibull(n, shape = shape_post, scale = scale_post))
  }

  u  <- runif(n)
  z  <- -log(u)

  H1c <- (c / scale_pre)^shape_pre

  t   <- numeric(n)

  idx1 <- z <= H1c
  if (any(idx1)) {
    t[idx1] <- scale_pre * (z[idx1])^(1 / shape_pre)
  }

  idx2 <- !idx1
  if (any(idx2)) {
    z2   <- z[idx2] - H1c
    t[idx2] <- c + scale_post * (z2)^(1 / shape_post)
  }

  t
}


average_event_probability_true <- function(S_fun, analysis_time, accrual_length) {
  if (!is.function(S_fun) || !is.finite(analysis_time) || analysis_time < 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  if (analysis_time == 0) {
    return(0)
  }
  if (!is.finite(accrual_length) || accrual_length <= 0) {
    return(1 - S_fun(analysis_time))
  }
  val <- tryCatch(
    integrate(
      function(u) 1 - S_fun(pmax(analysis_time - u, 0)),
      lower = 0, upper = accrual_length,
      subdivisions = 1000L, rel.tol = 1e-8
    )$value / accrual_length,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  pmin(pmax(val, 0), 1)
}


average_future_event_probability <- function(
    S_fun, L, accrual_start, accrual_end) {

  if (!is.function(S_fun) || !is.finite(L) ||
      !is.finite(accrual_start) || !is.finite(accrual_end)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  if (accrual_end < accrual_start) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  if (accrual_end == accrual_start) {
    if (L < accrual_start) return(0)
    val <- 1 - S_fun(pmax(L - accrual_start, 0))
    return(pmin(pmax(as.numeric(val), 0), 1))
  }

  upper_enroll <- min(accrual_end, L)
  if (upper_enroll <= accrual_start) return(0)

  area_fun <- attr(S_fun, "cum_surv_area", exact = TRUE)

  if (is.function(area_fun)) {
    x_lo <- pmax(L - upper_enroll, 0)
    x_hi <- pmax(L - accrual_start, 0)

    aa <- tryCatch(area_fun(c(x_lo, x_hi)),
                   error = function(e) c(NA_real_, NA_real_))

    if (length(aa) == 2L && all(is.finite(aa))) {
      surv_area <- aa[2] - aa[1]
      event_integral <- (upper_enroll - accrual_start) - surv_area
      val <- event_integral / (accrual_end - accrual_start)
      return(pmin(pmax(as.numeric(val), 0), 1))
    }
  }

  val <- tryCatch(
    integrate(
      function(u) 1 - S_fun(pmax(L - u, 0)),
      lower = accrual_start,
      upper = upper_enroll,
      subdivisions = 200L,
      rel.tol = 1e-6
    )$value / (accrual_end - accrual_start),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  pmin(pmax(val, 0), 1)
}

predict_final_event_time <- function(
    interim_data, interim_time,
    S_control, S_treatment,
    target_events,
    n1_total, n2_total,
    accrual_length,
    n_add = 0L,
    add_accrual_start = interim_time,
    add_accrual_end = interim_time) {

  if (!is.data.frame(interim_data) ||
      !all(c("time", "cens", "rec_time", "group") %in% names(interim_data)) ||
      !is.function(S_control) || !is.function(S_treatment) ||
      !is.finite(interim_time) || interim_time < 0 ||
      !is.finite(target_events) || target_events < 1 ||
      !is.finite(n1_total) || !is.finite(n2_total) ||
      !is.finite(accrual_length) || accrual_length < 0 ||
      !is.finite(n_add) || n_add < 0 ||
      !is.finite(add_accrual_start) || !is.finite(add_accrual_end) ||
      add_accrual_start < interim_time ||
      add_accrual_end < add_accrual_start) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  n_add <- as.integer(round(n_add))
  n_add_1 <- n_add %/% 2L
  n_add_2 <- n_add - n_add_1

  n_enrolled_1 <- sum(interim_data$group == 1)
  n_enrolled_2 <- sum(interim_data$group == 2)
  n_future_1 <- max(as.integer(round(n1_total)) - n_enrolled_1, 0L)
  n_future_2 <- max(as.integer(round(n2_total)) - n_enrolled_2, 0L)

  idx1 <- which(interim_data$group == 1)
  idx2 <- which(interim_data$group == 2)

  idx1_event <- idx1[interim_data$cens[idx1] == 1]
  idx2_event <- idx2[interim_data$cens[idx2] == 1]
  idx1_cens  <- idx1[interim_data$cens[idx1] == 0]
  idx2_cens  <- idx2[interim_data$cens[idx2] == 0]

  n_existing_events <- length(idx1_event) + length(idx2_event)

  t_obs1 <- pmax(interim_data$time[idx1_cens], 0)
  t_obs2 <- pmax(interim_data$time[idx2_cens], 0)
  rec1 <- interim_data$rec_time[idx1_cens]
  rec2 <- interim_data$rec_time[idx2_cens]

  S_obs1 <- if (length(idx1_cens) > 0L) {
    tryCatch(as.numeric(S_control(t_obs1)),
             error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(t_obs1)))
  } else numeric(0)

  S_obs2 <- if (length(idx2_cens) > 0L) {
    tryCatch(as.numeric(S_treatment(t_obs2)),
             error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(t_obs2)))
  } else numeric(0)

  if ((length(S_obs1) != length(idx1_cens)) ||
      (length(S_obs2) != length(idx2_cens)) ||
      any(!is.finite(S_obs1)) || any(!is.finite(S_obs2)) ||
      any(S_obs1 <= 0) || any(S_obs2 <= 0)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  expected_events <- function(L) {
    if (!is.finite(L) || L < interim_time) return(NA_real_)

    total <- as.numeric(n_existing_events)

    if (length(idx1_cens) > 0L) {
      t_end1 <- pmax(L - rec1, t_obs1)
      S_end1 <- tryCatch(as.numeric(S_control(t_end1)),
                         error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(t_end1)))
      if (length(S_end1) != length(idx1_cens) || any(!is.finite(S_end1))) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }
      p1 <- pmin(pmax(1 - S_end1 / S_obs1, 0), 1)
      total <- total + sum(p1)
    }

    if (length(idx2_cens) > 0L) {
      t_end2 <- pmax(L - rec2, t_obs2)
      S_end2 <- tryCatch(as.numeric(S_treatment(t_end2)),
                         error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(t_end2)))
      if (length(S_end2) != length(idx2_cens) || any(!is.finite(S_end2))) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }
      p2 <- pmin(pmax(1 - S_end2 / S_obs2, 0), 1)
      total <- total + sum(p2)
    }

    if (n_future_1 > 0L) {
      if (accrual_length <= interim_time) return(NA_real_)
      p <- average_future_event_probability(
        S_control, L, interim_time, accrual_length
      )
      if (!is.finite(p)) return(NA_real_)
      total <- total + n_future_1 * p
    }

    if (n_future_2 > 0L) {
      if (accrual_length <= interim_time) return(NA_real_)
      p <- average_future_event_probability(
        S_treatment, L, interim_time, accrual_length
      )
      if (!is.finite(p)) return(NA_real_)
      total <- total + n_future_2 * p
    }

    if (n_add_1 > 0L) {
      p <- average_future_event_probability(
        S_control, L, add_accrual_start, add_accrual_end
      )
      if (!is.finite(p)) return(NA_real_)
      total <- total + n_add_1 * p
    }

    if (n_add_2 > 0L) {
      p <- average_future_event_probability(
        S_treatment, L, add_accrual_start, add_accrual_end
      )
      if (!is.finite(p)) return(NA_real_)
      total <- total + n_add_2 * p
    }

    total
  }

  f_lower <- expected_events(interim_time) - target_events
  if (!is.finite(f_lower)) return(NA_real_)
  if (f_lower >= 0) return(interim_time)

  upper <- max(
    interim_time + 1,
    accrual_length + 1,
    add_accrual_end + 1
  )

  f_upper <- expected_events(upper) - target_events
  n_expand <- 0L
  while ((!is.finite(f_upper) || f_upper < 0) && n_expand < 60L) {
    upper <- interim_time + 2 * (upper - interim_time)
    f_upper <- expected_events(upper) - target_events
    n_expand <- n_expand + 1L
  }

  if (!is.finite(f_upper) || f_upper < 0) return(NA_real_)

  tryCatch(
    uniroot(
      function(L) expected_events(L) - target_events,
      lower = interim_time,
      upper = upper,
      tol = 1e-5
    )$root,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

expected_stage2_logrank_at_time <- function(
    interim_data, interim_time, final_time,
    S_control, S_treatment,
    n1_total, n2_total, accrual_length,
    n_add = 0L, add_accrual_length = 0,
    add_accrual_start = interim_time,
    fixed_followup = FIXED_FOLLOWUP,
    n_grid = 30L, n_accrual_grid = 10L, return_path = FALSE) {

  if (!is.data.frame(interim_data) ||
      !all(c("time", "cens", "rec_time", "group") %in% names(interim_data)) ||
      !is.function(S_control) || !is.function(S_treatment) ||
      !is.finite(interim_time) || !is.finite(final_time) ||
      final_time <= interim_time ||
      !is.finite(n1_total) || !is.finite(n2_total) ||
      !is.finite(accrual_length) || accrual_length < 0 ||
      !is.finite(n_add) || n_add < 0 ||
      !is.finite(add_accrual_length) || add_accrual_length < 0 ||
      !is.finite(add_accrual_start) || add_accrual_start < interim_time ||
      !is.finite(fixed_followup) || fixed_followup <= 0) {
    return(list(U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_))
  }

  tt <- seq(interim_time, final_time, length.out = as.integer(n_grid) + 1L)

  n_add <- as.integer(round(n_add))
  n_add_1 <- n_add %/% 2L
  n_add_2 <- n_add - n_add_1

  prepare_arm <- function(g, S_fun, n_total_arm) {
    idx_cens <- which(interim_data$group == g & interim_data$cens == 0)
    rj <- interim_data$rec_time[idx_cens]
    tobs <- pmax(interim_data$time[idx_cens], 0)

    Sobs <- if (length(idx_cens) > 0L) {
      tryCatch(as.numeric(S_fun(tobs)),
               error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(tobs)))
    } else numeric(0)

    if (length(Sobs) != length(tobs) ||
        any(!is.finite(Sobs)) || any(Sobs <= 0)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    n_enrolled <- sum(interim_data$group == g)
    n_future <- max(as.integer(round(n_total_arm)) - n_enrolled, 0L)

    list(
      idx_cens = idx_cens,
      rj = rj,
      tobs = tobs,
      Sobs = Sobs,
      n_future = n_future
    )
  }

  prep1 <- prepare_arm(1L, S_control, n1_total)
  prep2 <- prepare_arm(2L, S_treatment, n2_total)
  if (is.null(prep1) || is.null(prep2)) {
    return(list(U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_))
  }

  make_cohort_design <- function(accrual_start, accrual_end) {
    if (!is.finite(accrual_start) || !is.finite(accrual_end) ||
        accrual_end < accrual_start) return(NULL)

    if (accrual_end == accrual_start) {
      uu <- accrual_start
    } else {
      m <- max(10L, as.integer(n_accrual_grid))
      br <- seq(accrual_start, accrual_end, length.out = m + 1L)
      uu <- (head(br, -1) + tail(br, -1)) / 2
    }

    age <- outer(tt, uu, "-")
    list(
      enrolled = age >= 0,
      at_risk = age >= 0 & age <= fixed_followup,
      age0 = pmin(pmax(age, 0), fixed_followup),
      n_u = length(uu)
    )
  }

  original_design <- if (prep1$n_future > 0L || prep2$n_future > 0L) {
    if (accrual_length <= interim_time) NULL
    else make_cohort_design(interim_time, accrual_length)
  } else {
    list(enrolled = NULL, age0 = NULL, n_u = 0L)
  }

  added_design <- if (n_add_1 > 0L || n_add_2 > 0L) {
    make_cohort_design(add_accrual_start, add_accrual_start + add_accrual_length)
  } else {
    list(enrolled = NULL, age0 = NULL, n_u = 0L)
  }

  if ((prep1$n_future > 0L || prep2$n_future > 0L) && is.null(original_design)) {
    return(list(U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_))
  }
  if ((n_add_1 > 0L || n_add_2 > 0L) && is.null(added_design)) {
    return(list(U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_))
  }

  add_future_cohort <- function(n_cohort, design, S_fun) {
    if (n_cohort <= 0L) {
      return(list(Y = numeric(length(tt)), C = numeric(length(tt))))
    }
    if (is.null(design) || design$n_u <= 0L) return(NULL)

    Sv <- tryCatch(
      matrix(
        as.numeric(S_fun(as.vector(design$age0))),
        nrow = length(tt),
        ncol = design$n_u
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(Sv) || any(!is.finite(Sv))) return(NULL)
    Sv <- pmin(pmax(Sv, 0), 1)

    Yc <- n_cohort * rowMeans(Sv * design$at_risk)
    Cc <- n_cohort * rowMeans((1 - Sv) * design$enrolled)
    list(Y = Yc, C = Cc)
  }

  arm_path <- function(prep, S_fun, n_add_arm) {
    Y <- numeric(length(tt))
    C <- numeric(length(tt))

    if (length(prep$idx_cens) > 0L) {
      raw_age <- outer(tt, prep$rj, "-")
      age <- pmax(
        raw_age,
        matrix(
          prep$tobs,
          nrow = length(tt),
          ncol = length(prep$tobs),
          byrow = TRUE
        )
      )
      age <- pmin(age, fixed_followup)

      Send <- tryCatch(
        matrix(
          as.numeric(S_fun(as.vector(age))),
          nrow = length(tt),
          ncol = length(prep$rj)
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(Send) || any(!is.finite(Send))) return(NULL)

      Q <- sweep(Send, 2L, prep$Sobs, "/")
      Q <- pmin(pmax(Q, 0), 1)

      at_risk <- raw_age <= fixed_followup
      Y <- Y + rowSums(Q * at_risk)
      C <- C + rowSums(1 - Q)
    }

    if (prep$n_future > 0L) {
      z <- add_future_cohort(prep$n_future, original_design, S_fun)
      if (is.null(z)) return(NULL)
      Y <- Y + z$Y
      C <- C + z$C
    }

    if (n_add_arm > 0L) {
      z <- add_future_cohort(n_add_arm, added_design, S_fun)
      if (is.null(z)) return(NULL)
      Y <- Y + z$Y
      C <- C + z$C
    }

    list(Y = Y, C = C)
  }

  a1 <- arm_path(prep1, S_control, n_add_1)
  a2 <- arm_path(prep2, S_treatment, n_add_2)
  if (is.null(a1) || is.null(a2)) {
    return(list(U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_))
  }

  dN1 <- pmax(diff(a1$C), 0)
  dN2 <- pmax(diff(a2$C), 0)
  dN <- dN1 + dN2
  Y1 <- head(a1$Y, -1)
  Y2 <- head(a2$Y, -1)
  Ytot <- Y1 + Y2

  ok <- is.finite(Ytot) & Ytot > 1e-10 & is.finite(dN) & dN >= 0
  if (!any(ok)) {
    return(list(U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_))
  }

  U2_trt <- sum(
    dN2[ok] - (Y2[ok] / Ytot[ok]) * dN[ok]
  )
  I2 <- sum(
    (Y1[ok] * Y2[ok] / (Ytot[ok]^2)) * dN[ok]
  )
  U2_gs <- -U2_trt
  mu_z2 <- if (is.finite(I2) && I2 > 0) U2_gs / sqrt(I2) else NA_real_

  if (isTRUE(return_path)) {
    Uinc_gs <- -(dN2 - (Y2 / pmax(Ytot, 1e-12)) * dN)
    Iinc <- (Y1 * Y2 / pmax(Ytot^2, 1e-12)) * dN
    Uinc_gs[!ok] <- 0
    Iinc[!ok] <- 0
    return(list(
      U2_gs = U2_gs, I2 = I2, mu_z2 = mu_z2,
      time = tt[-1],
      future_events = cumsum(dN),
      cum_U2_gs = cumsum(Uinc_gs),
      cum_I2 = cumsum(Iinc)
    ))
  }

  list(U2_gs = U2_gs, I2 = I2, mu_z2 = mu_z2)
}

build_chw_logrank_path <- function(
    D_max, z1_gs, x_gs,
    interim_data, interim_time,
    S_control, S_treatment,
    n1_total, n2_total, accrual_length,
    n_add = 0L, add_accrual_length = 0) {

  L_max <- predict_final_event_time(
    interim_data = interim_data, interim_time = interim_time,
    S_control = S_control, S_treatment = S_treatment,
    target_events = D_max,
    n1_total = n1_total, n2_total = n2_total,
    accrual_length = accrual_length,
    n_add = n_add, add_accrual_start = max(accrual_length, interim_time),
    add_accrual_end = max(accrual_length, interim_time) + add_accrual_length
  )
  if (!is.finite(L_max) || L_max <= interim_time) return(NULL)

  zcrit2 <- tryCatch(as.numeric(z2NC(z1 = z1_gs, x = x_gs)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (!is.finite(zcrit2)) return(NULL)

  path <- expected_stage2_logrank_at_time(
    interim_data = interim_data, interim_time = interim_time, final_time = L_max,
    S_control = S_control, S_treatment = S_treatment,
    n1_total = n1_total, n2_total = n2_total,
    accrual_length = accrual_length,
    n_add = n_add, add_accrual_length = add_accrual_length,
    return_path = TRUE
  )
  if (is.null(path$future_events) || any(!is.finite(path$future_events))) return(NULL)

  path$interim_events <- sum(interim_data$cens)
  path$zcrit2 <- zcrit2
  path$L_max <- L_max

  Dpath <- path$interim_events + path$future_events
  keep <- is.finite(Dpath) & is.finite(path$cum_U2_gs) & is.finite(path$cum_I2)
  Dpath <- Dpath[keep]
  Upath <- path$cum_U2_gs[keep]
  Ipath <- path$cum_I2[keep]
  Tpath <- path$time[keep]
  nd <- !duplicated(Dpath)
  path$Dpath_eval <- Dpath[nd]
  path$Upath_eval <- Upath[nd]
  path$Ipath_eval <- Ipath[nd]
  path$Tpath_eval <- Tpath[nd]
  path
}

cp_from_chw_logrank_path <- function(path, target_events) {
  if (is.null(path) || !is.finite(target_events)) {
    return(list(cp = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_, U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, L_pred = NA_real_))
  }

  if (!is.null(path$Dpath_eval)) {
    Dpath <- path$Dpath_eval
    Upath <- path$Upath_eval
    Ipath <- path$Ipath_eval
    Tpath <- path$Tpath_eval
  } else {
    Dpath <- path$interim_events + path$future_events
    keep <- is.finite(Dpath) & is.finite(path$cum_U2_gs) & is.finite(path$cum_I2)
    Dpath <- Dpath[keep]
    Upath <- path$cum_U2_gs[keep]
    Ipath <- path$cum_I2[keep]
    Tpath <- path$time[keep]
    nd <- !duplicated(Dpath)
    Dpath <- Dpath[nd]; Upath <- Upath[nd]; Ipath <- Ipath[nd]; Tpath <- Tpath[nd]
  }
  if (length(Dpath) < 2L || max(Dpath) + 1e-8 < target_events) {
    return(list(cp = NA_real_, mu_z2 = NA_real_, U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_, L_pred = NA_real_))
  }

  U <- approx(Dpath, Upath, xout = target_events, rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
  I <- approx(Dpath, Ipath, xout = target_events, rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
  L <- approx(Dpath, Tpath, xout = target_events, rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
  mu <- if (is.finite(I) && I > 0) U / sqrt(I) else NA_real_
  cp <- if (is.finite(mu)) pnorm(mu - path$zcrit2) else NA_real_
  list(cp = cp, mu_z2 = mu, U2_gs = U, I2 = I, L_pred = L)
}


cp_many_from_chw_logrank_path <- function(path, target_events) {
  target_events <- as.numeric(target_events)
  nout <- length(target_events)
  if (is.null(path) || nout == 0L || any(!is.finite(target_events))) {
    return(data.frame(
      target_events = target_events,
      cp = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      mu_z2 = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      U2_gs = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      I2 = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      L_pred = rep(NA_real_, nout)
    ))
  }

  if (!is.null(path$Dpath_eval)) {
    Dpath <- path$Dpath_eval
    Upath <- path$Upath_eval
    Ipath <- path$Ipath_eval
    Tpath <- path$Tpath_eval
  } else {
    Dpath <- path$interim_events + path$future_events
    keep <- is.finite(Dpath) & is.finite(path$cum_U2_gs) & is.finite(path$cum_I2)
    Dpath <- Dpath[keep]
    Upath <- path$cum_U2_gs[keep]
    Ipath <- path$cum_I2[keep]
    Tpath <- path$time[keep]
    nd <- !duplicated(Dpath)
    Dpath <- Dpath[nd]; Upath <- Upath[nd]; Ipath <- Ipath[nd]; Tpath <- Tpath[nd]
  }

  if (length(Dpath) < 2L) {
    return(data.frame(
      target_events = target_events,
      cp = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      mu_z2 = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      U2_gs = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      I2 = rep(NA_real_, nout),
      L_pred = rep(NA_real_, nout)
    ))
  }

  evaluable <- target_events <= max(Dpath) + 1e-8
  U <- I <- L <- rep(NA_real_, nout)
  if (any(evaluable)) {
    U[evaluable] <- approx(Dpath, Upath, xout = target_events[evaluable], rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
    I[evaluable] <- approx(Dpath, Ipath, xout = target_events[evaluable], rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
    L[evaluable] <- approx(Dpath, Tpath, xout = target_events[evaluable], rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
  }
  mu <- ifelse(is.finite(I) & I > 0, U / sqrt(I), NA_real_)
  cp <- ifelse(is.finite(mu), pnorm(mu - path$zcrit2), NA_real_)

  data.frame(
    target_events = target_events,
    cp = cp,
    mu_z2 = mu,
    U2_gs = U,
    I2 = I,
    L_pred = L
  )
}

predict_chw_cp_for_event_target <- function(
    target_events, z1_gs, x_gs,
    interim_data, interim_time,
    S_control, S_treatment,
    n1_total, n2_total, accrual_length,
    n_add = 0L, add_accrual_length = 0,
    L_pred_override = NULL) {

  L_pred <- if (!is.null(L_pred_override) && length(L_pred_override) == 1L &&
                is.finite(L_pred_override)) {
    as.numeric(L_pred_override)
  } else predict_final_event_time(
    interim_data = interim_data,
    interim_time = interim_time,
    S_control = S_control,
    S_treatment = S_treatment,
    target_events = target_events,
    n1_total = n1_total,
    n2_total = n2_total,
    accrual_length = accrual_length,
    n_add = n_add,
    add_accrual_start = max(accrual_length, interim_time),
    add_accrual_end = max(accrual_length, interim_time) + add_accrual_length
  )

  if (!is.finite(L_pred) || L_pred <= interim_time) {
    return(list(cp = NA_real_, L_pred = L_pred, mu_z2 = NA_real_, U2_gs = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_))
  }

  pred <- expected_stage2_logrank_at_time(
    interim_data = interim_data,
    interim_time = interim_time,
    final_time = L_pred,
    S_control = S_control,
    S_treatment = S_treatment,
    n1_total = n1_total,
    n2_total = n2_total,
    accrual_length = accrual_length,
    n_add = n_add,
    add_accrual_length = add_accrual_length
  )

  zcrit2 <- tryCatch(as.numeric(z2NC(z1 = z1_gs, x = x_gs)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  cp <- if (is.finite(pred$mu_z2) && is.finite(zcrit2)) {
    pnorm(pred$mu_z2 - zcrit2)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  list(
    cp = cp,
    L_pred = L_pred,
    mu_z2 = pred$mu_z2,
    U2_gs = pred$U2_gs,
    I2 = pred$I2
  )
}

find_D_for_target_cp_logrank <- function(
    target_cp, D_min, D_max, z1_gs, x_gs,
    interim_data, interim_time,
    S_control, S_treatment,
    n1_total, n2_total, accrual_length) {

  path <- build_chw_logrank_path(
    D_max = D_max,
    z1_gs = z1_gs, x_gs = x_gs,
    interim_data = interim_data, interim_time = interim_time,
    S_control = S_control, S_treatment = S_treatment,
    n1_total = n1_total, n2_total = n2_total,
    accrual_length = accrual_length
  )
  if (is.null(path)) return(list(D = NA_real_, pred = NULL, path = NULL))

  pred_min <- cp_from_chw_logrank_path(path, D_min)
  if (!is.finite(pred_min$cp)) return(list(D = NA_real_, pred = pred_min, path = path))
  if (pred_min$cp >= target_cp) return(list(D = D_min, pred = pred_min, path = path))

  lo <- max(ceiling(D_min + 1e-8), ceiling(D_min))
  hi <- floor(D_max)
  if (lo > hi) return(list(D = D_max, pred = pred_min, path = path))

  pred_last <- pred_min
  for (Dc in seq.int(lo, hi)) {
    pc <- cp_from_chw_logrank_path(path, Dc)
    if (!is.finite(pc$cp)) return(list(D = NA_real_, pred = pc, path = path))
    pred_last <- pc
    if (pc$cp >= target_cp) return(list(D = Dc, pred = pc, path = path))
  }

  list(D = hi, pred = pred_last, path = path)
}

predict_true_event_time_uniform <- function(
    S_control, S_treatment, n_total, accrual_length, target_events) {

  if (!is.function(S_control) || !is.function(S_treatment) ||
      !is.finite(n_total) || n_total <= 0 ||
      !is.finite(accrual_length) || accrual_length < 0 ||
      !is.finite(target_events) || target_events <= 0 ||
      target_events >= n_total) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  expected_events <- function(L) {
    p_control <- average_event_probability_true(
      S_control, L, accrual_length
    )
    p_treatment <- average_event_probability_true(
      S_treatment, L, accrual_length
    )

    if (!all(is.finite(c(p_control, p_treatment)))) return(NA_real_)

    (n_total / 2) * (p_control + p_treatment)
  }

  lower <- 0
  upper <- max(accrual_length + 1, 1)
  f_upper <- expected_events(upper) - target_events
  n_expand <- 0L

  while ((!is.finite(f_upper) || f_upper < 0) && n_expand < 60L) {
    upper <- max(2 * upper, upper + 1)
    f_upper <- expected_events(upper) - target_events
    n_expand <- n_expand + 1L
  }

  if (!is.finite(f_upper) || f_upper < 0) return(NA_real_)

  tryCatch(
    uniroot(
      function(L) expected_events(L) - target_events,
      lower = lower,
      upper = upper,
      tol = 1e-8
    )$root,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}


# Run simulations
simu <- function(type, alpha, beta,
                 rate1, rate2,
                 c_shape_pre, c_shape_post,
                 c_scale_pre, c_scale_post,
                 t_shape_pre, t_shape_post,
                 t_scale_pre, t_scale_post,
                 change1, change2,
                 rec, CL, CU,
                 num_simulations,
                 extrap_dist,
                 event_generator_control = NULL,
                 event_generator_treatment = NULL,
                 S_control_override = NULL,
                 S_treatment_override = NULL) {

  if (length(rec) > 1L) {
    rec_values <- rec
    current_call <- match.call()
    caller_env <- parent.frame()
    rec_results <- lapply(rec_values, function(rec_i) {
      current_call$rec <- rec_i
      eval(current_call, envir = caller_env)
    })
    rec_results <- rec_results[!vapply(rec_results, is.null, logical(1))]
    if (length(rec_results) == 0L) return(NULL)
    return(do.call(rbind, rec_results))
  }

  alpha_one_sided <- 0.025
  z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha_one_sided)
  z_beta  <- qnorm(1 - beta)         
  z_total <- z_alpha + z_beta

  lambda1 <- -log(1 - rate1)
  lambda2 <- -log(1 - rate2)
  HR      <- lambda2 / lambda1
  if (!is.finite(HR) || HR <= 0) HR <- 0.99
  logHR   <- log(HR)

  FIXED_FOLLOWUP <- 5

  d_required <- 4 * (z_total / logHR)^2

  design_event_prob1 <- 1 - exp(-lambda1 * FIXED_FOLLOWUP)
  design_event_prob2 <- 1 - exp(-lambda2 * FIXED_FOLLOWUP)
  design_pooled_event_prob <- (design_event_prob1 + design_event_prob2) / 2

  n <- ceiling(d_required / design_pooled_event_prob / 2) * 2
  n1 <- n / 2
  n2 <- n / 2
  d <- ceiling(n * design_pooled_event_prob)
  d_half <- ceiling(d / 2)

  x_gs <- make_gs_design(
    d_half = d_half, d = d,
    alpha_one_sided = alpha_one_sided, beta = beta
  )
  theta_design_gs <- x_gs$theta[2]
  w1_chw <- sqrt(x_gs$n.I[1] / x_gs$n.I[2])
  w2_chw <- sqrt(1 - x_gs$n.I[1] / x_gs$n.I[2])

  rec_length <- rec

  final_results <- vector("list", as.integer(num_simulations))
  count_simu <- 0L

  fail_interim_event_target <- 0L
  fail_interim_arm_information <- 0L
  fail_extrapolation_model <- 0L
  fail_extrapolation_prediction <- 0L
  fail_interim_logrank <- 0L
  fail_conditional_power <- 0L
  fail_ssr_target <- 0L
  fail_final_event_target <- 0L
  fail_final_logrank <- 0L
  fail_original_final_logrank <- 0L
  fail_saved_replicate_nonfinite <- 0L

  for (i in 1:num_simulations) {

    if (is.function(event_generator_control)) {
      event_time1 <- event_generator_control(n1)
    } else {
      event_time1 <- rweibull_piecewise(
        n          = n1,
        shape_pre  = c_shape_pre,
        scale_pre  = c_scale_pre,
        shape_post = c_shape_post,
        scale_post = c_scale_post,
        c          = change1
      )
    }

    if (is.function(event_generator_treatment)) {
      event_time2 <- event_generator_treatment(n2)
    } else {
      event_time2 <- rweibull_piecewise(
        n          = n2,
        shape_pre  = t_shape_pre,
        scale_pre  = t_scale_pre,
        shape_post = t_shape_post,
        scale_post = t_scale_post,
        c          = change2
      )
    }

    event_time <- c(event_time1, event_time2)
    group      <- c(rep(1, n1), rep(2, n2))
    subj       <- 1:n

    rec_time   <- runif(n, 0, rec_length)
    study_time <- rec_time + event_time

    all_data <- data.frame(
      study_time = study_time,
      event_time = event_time,
      rec_time   = rec_time,
      group      = group,
      subj       = subj
    )

    k_plan <- ceiling(d)

    eligible_event_times <- all_data$study_time[all_data$event_time <= FIXED_FOLLOWUP]
    ord_times <- sort(eligible_event_times)
    if (length(ord_times) < d_half) {
      fail_interim_event_target <- fail_interim_event_target + 1L
      next
    }
    interim_time <- ord_times[d_half]

    i_data <- all_data[all_data$rec_time < interim_time, , drop = FALSE]
    interim_available_fu <- pmin(
      pmax(interim_time - i_data$rec_time, 0),
      FIXED_FOLLOWUP
    )
    i_data$cens <- as.integer(i_data$event_time <= interim_available_fu)
    i_data$time <- pmin(i_data$event_time, interim_available_fu)
    i_data$time[i_data$time < 0] <- 0

    i_data_1 <- i_data[i_data$group == 1,]
    i_data_2 <- i_data[i_data$group == 2,]

    if (nrow(i_data_1) == 0 || nrow(i_data_2) == 0 ||
        sum(i_data_1$cens) < 1 || sum(i_data_2$cens) < 1) {
      fail_interim_arm_information <- fail_interim_arm_information + 1L
      next
    }

    i1 <- sum(i_data$cens)

S1_hat <- make_hybrid_km_parametric(i_data_1$time, i_data_1$cens, extrap_dist)
S2_hat <- make_hybrid_km_parametric(i_data_2$time, i_data_2$cens, extrap_dist)

if (is.null(S1_hat) || !is.function(S1_hat) ||
    is.null(S2_hat) || !is.function(S2_hat)) {
  fail_extrapolation_model <- fail_extrapolation_model + 1L
  next
}

t_last_1 <- if (any(i_data_1$cens == 1)) max(i_data_1$time[i_data_1$cens == 1]) else max(i_data_1$time)
t_last_2 <- if (any(i_data_2$cens == 1)) max(i_data_2$time[i_data_2$cens == 1]) else max(i_data_2$time)

t_end_max1 <- FIXED_FOLLOWUP
t_end_max2 <- FIXED_FOLLOWUP

tmax_1 <- max(2 * FIXED_FOLLOWUP, 3 * t_last_1)
tmax_2 <- max(2 * FIXED_FOLLOWUP, 3 * t_last_2)

mst_hat_1 <- mst_from_S(S1_hat, t_max = tmax_1)
mst_hat_2 <- mst_from_S(S2_hat, t_max = tmax_2)

mst_hat_overall <- mean(c(mst_hat_1, mst_hat_2), na.rm = TRUE)


if (is.function(S_control_override)) {
  S1_true <- S_control_override
} else {
  S1_true <- function(t) S_pieceweib(t, c_shape_pre, c_scale_pre, c_shape_post, c_scale_post, change1)
}
if (is.function(S_treatment_override)) {
  S2_true <- S_treatment_override
} else {
  S2_true <- function(t) S_pieceweib(t, t_shape_pre, t_scale_pre, t_shape_post, t_scale_post, change2)
}

mst_true_1 <- mst_from_S(S1_true, t_max = tmax_1)
mst_true_2 <- mst_from_S(S2_true, t_max = tmax_2)

mst_true_overall <- mean(c(mst_true_1, mst_true_2), na.rm = TRUE)


if (!valid_survival_function(S1_hat, tmax_1) ||
    !valid_survival_function(S2_hat, tmax_2) ||
    !is.finite(mst_hat_1) || !is.finite(mst_hat_2) ||
    mst_hat_1 <= 0 || mst_hat_2 <= 0) {
  fail_extrapolation_prediction <- fail_extrapolation_prediction + 1L
  next
}


p1_raw <- 1 - as.numeric(S1_hat(FIXED_FOLLOWUP))[1]
p2_raw <- 1 - as.numeric(S2_hat(FIXED_FOLLOWUP))[1]


    if (!is.finite(p1_raw) || !is.finite(p2_raw) ||
        is.na(p1_raw)      || is.na(p2_raw)      ||
        p1_raw <= 0        || p2_raw <= 0        ||
        p1_raw >= 1        || p2_raw >= 1) {

      fail_extrapolation_prediction <- fail_extrapolation_prediction + 1L
      next
    }

    p1w <- p1_raw
    p2w <- p2_raw

i1 <- sum(i_data$cens)
tmp1 <- tryCatch(
  survdiff(Surv(time, cens) ~ factor(group), data = i_data),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (is.null(tmp1)) {
  fail_interim_logrank <- fail_interim_logrank + 1L
  next
}
OE1 <- tmp1$obs - tmp1$exp
U1  <- as.numeric(OE1[2])
I1  <- as.numeric(tmp1$var[1,1])
if (!is.finite(U1) || !is.finite(I1) || I1 <= 0) {
  fail_interim_logrank <- fail_interim_logrank + 1L
  next
}
Z1 <- U1 / sqrt(I1)
if (!is.finite(Z1)) {
  fail_interim_logrank <- fail_interim_logrank + 1L
  next
}

    nlhr_star <- -log(-log(1 - p2w)) + log(-log(1 - p1w))
    if (!is.finite(nlhr_star)) {
      fail_extrapolation_prediction <- fail_extrapolation_prediction + 1L
      next
    }

    Z1_gs <- -Z1
    interim_treatment_favored <- is.finite(Z1_gs) && (Z1_gs > 0)

    theta_future_calendar_end <- rec_length + FIXED_FOLLOWUP
    future_lr_prediction <- expected_stage2_logrank_at_time(
      interim_data = i_data,
      interim_time = interim_time,
      final_time = theta_future_calendar_end,
      S_control = S1_hat,
      S_treatment = S2_hat,
      n1_total = n1,
      n2_total = n2,
      accrual_length = rec_length,
      n_add = 0L,
      add_accrual_length = 0,
      return_path = TRUE
    )

    predicted_future_events <- if (!is.null(future_lr_prediction$future_events) &&
                                   length(future_lr_prediction$future_events) > 0L) {
      tail(future_lr_prediction$future_events, 1L)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    theta_future_lr <- if (is.finite(future_lr_prediction$mu_z2) &&
                           is.finite(predicted_future_events) &&
                           predicted_future_events > 0) {
      future_lr_prediction$mu_z2 / sqrt(predicted_future_events)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    if (!is.finite(theta_future_lr)) {
      fail_extrapolation_prediction <- fail_extrapolation_prediction + 1L
      next
    }

    pred_cp_d <- analytic_chw_cp_vector(
      target_events = d,
      interim_events = i1,
      z1_gs = Z1_gs,
      x_gs = x_gs,
      theta_logrank = theta_future_lr
    )
    CP_no_inc <- pred_cp_d$cp[1]

    CP_design_assumption <- gs_cond_power(
      z1_gs = Z1_gs, D_total = d, x_gs = x_gs, theta = theta_design_gs
    )

    if (!is.finite(CP_no_inc) || CP_no_inc < 0 || CP_no_inc > 1 ||
        !is.finite(CP_design_assumption) ||
        !is.finite(pred_cp_d$mu_z2[1])) {
      fail_conditional_power <- fail_conditional_power + 1L
      next
    }

    in_resize_zone <- is.finite(CP_no_inc) &&
                      (CP_no_inc >= CL) &&
                      (CP_no_inc < CU)

    target_cp_ssr <- 0.9
    predicted_future_benefit <- theta_future_lr > 1e-8
    interim_treatment_favored <- is.finite(Z1_gs) && (Z1_gs > 0)

    if (in_resize_zone && interim_treatment_favored && predicted_future_benefit) {
      if (CP_no_inc >= target_cp_ssr) {
        d_star_extrap_raw <- d
      } else {
        d_star_extrap_raw <- floor(2 * d)
        Dc_seq <- seq.int(ceiling(d + 1e-8), floor(2 * d))
        cp_seq <- analytic_chw_cp_vector(
          target_events = Dc_seq,
          interim_events = i1,
          z1_gs = Z1_gs,
          x_gs = x_gs,
          theta_logrank = theta_future_lr
        )
        if (any(!is.finite(cp_seq$cp))) {
          fail_ssr_target <- fail_ssr_target + 1L
          d_star_extrap_raw <- NA_real_
        } else {
          hit <- which(cp_seq$cp >= target_cp_ssr)
          if (length(hit) > 0L) d_star_extrap_raw <- Dc_seq[hit[1L]]
        }
      }
    } else {
      d_star_extrap_raw <- d
    }

    if (!is.finite(d_star_extrap_raw)) next
    d_star_cap <- if (d_star_extrap_raw <= d + 1e-8) {
      d
    } else {
      min(ceiling(d_star_extrap_raw), floor(2 * d))
    }
    if (!is.finite(d_star_cap) || d_star_cap < d ||
        d_star_cap > 2 * d + 1e-8) {
      fail_ssr_target <- fail_ssr_target + 1L
      next
    }

    allow_ssr <- (type == "Unblinded") &&
                 interim_treatment_favored &&
                 predicted_future_benefit &&
                 in_resize_zone

    d_star <- if (allow_ssr && d_star_cap > d) max(d, d_star_cap) else d

    pooled_event_prob <- (p1w + p2w) / 2
    n_star_raw <- if (allow_ssr) d_star / pooled_event_prob else n
    n_new_target <- max(n, ceiling(n_star_raw / 2) * 2)

    if (!is.finite(n_new_target) || n_new_target < n) {
      fail_ssr_target <- fail_ssr_target + 1L
      next
    }

    if (allow_ssr && n_new_target > n) {
      n_add_pred <- n_new_target - n
      add_rec_length_pred <- rec_length * (n_add_pred / n)
      add_accrual_start_pred <- max(rec_length, interim_time)
      adapted_final_time_pred <- add_accrual_start_pred +
                                 add_rec_length_pred +
                                 FIXED_FOLLOWUP

      future_lr_prediction_refined <- expected_stage2_logrank_at_time(
        interim_data = i_data,
        interim_time = interim_time,
        final_time = adapted_final_time_pred,
        S_control = S1_hat,
        S_treatment = S2_hat,
        n1_total = n1,
        n2_total = n2,
        accrual_length = rec_length,
        n_add = n_add_pred,
        add_accrual_length = add_rec_length_pred,
        add_accrual_start = add_accrual_start_pred,
        return_path = TRUE
      )

      predicted_future_events_refined <-
        if (!is.null(future_lr_prediction_refined$future_events) &&
            length(future_lr_prediction_refined$future_events) > 0L) {
          tail(future_lr_prediction_refined$future_events, 1L)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }

      theta_future_lr_refined <-
        if (is.finite(future_lr_prediction_refined$mu_z2) &&
            is.finite(predicted_future_events_refined) &&
            predicted_future_events_refined > 0) {
          future_lr_prediction_refined$mu_z2 /
            sqrt(predicted_future_events_refined)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }

      if (!is.finite(theta_future_lr_refined)) {
        fail_extrapolation_prediction <- fail_extrapolation_prediction + 1L
        next
      }

      pred_cp_d_refined <- analytic_chw_cp_vector(
        target_events = d,
        interim_events = i1,
        z1_gs = Z1_gs,
        x_gs = x_gs,
        theta_logrank = theta_future_lr_refined
      )

      if (!is.finite(pred_cp_d_refined$cp[1])) {
        fail_conditional_power <- fail_conditional_power + 1L
        next
      }

      if (pred_cp_d_refined$cp[1] >= target_cp_ssr) {
        d_star_refined_raw <- d
      } else {
        d_star_refined_raw <- floor(2 * d)
        Dc_seq_refined <- seq.int(ceiling(d + 1e-8), floor(2 * d))
        cp_seq_refined <- analytic_chw_cp_vector(
          target_events = Dc_seq_refined,
          interim_events = i1,
          z1_gs = Z1_gs,
          x_gs = x_gs,
          theta_logrank = theta_future_lr_refined
        )

        if (any(!is.finite(cp_seq_refined$cp))) {
          fail_ssr_target <- fail_ssr_target + 1L
          next
        }

        hit_refined <- which(cp_seq_refined$cp >= target_cp_ssr)
        if (length(hit_refined) > 0L) {
          d_star_refined_raw <- Dc_seq_refined[hit_refined[1L]]
        }
      }

      d_star_refined_cap <- if (d_star_refined_raw <= d + 1e-8) {
        d
      } else {
        min(ceiling(d_star_refined_raw), floor(2 * d))
      }

      if (!is.finite(d_star_refined_cap) ||
          d_star_refined_cap < d ||
          d_star_refined_cap > 2 * d + 1e-8) {
        fail_ssr_target <- fail_ssr_target + 1L
        next
      }

      d_star <- max(d, d_star_refined_cap)
      n_star_raw <- d_star / pooled_event_prob
      n_new_target <- max(n, ceiling(n_star_raw / 2) * 2)

      if (!is.finite(n_new_target) || n_new_target < n) {
        fail_ssr_target <- fail_ssr_target + 1L
        next
      }

      theta_future_lr <- theta_future_lr_refined
    }

    rmst_hat_1 <- rmst_from_S(S1_hat, tau = 5)
    rmst_hat_2 <- rmst_from_S(S2_hat, tau = 5)
    rmst_true_1 <- rmst_from_S(S1_true, tau = 5)
    rmst_true_2 <- rmst_from_S(S2_true, tau = 5)

    if (any(!is.finite(c(
      rmst_hat_1, rmst_hat_2, rmst_true_1, rmst_true_2
    )))) {
      fail_extrapolation_prediction <- fail_extrapolation_prediction + 1L
      next
    }

    incD    <- as.integer(d_star > d)
    incN    <- as.integer(n_new_target > n)

    D_ratio <- d_star / d
    N_ratio <- n_new_target / n

    pred_cp_after <- analytic_chw_cp_vector(
      target_events = d_star,
      interim_events = i1,
      z1_gs = Z1_gs,
      x_gs = x_gs,
      theta_logrank = theta_future_lr
    )
    CP_after_SSR <- pred_cp_after$cp[1]

    if (!is.finite(CP_after_SSR) || CP_after_SSR < 0 || CP_after_SSR > 1) {
      fail_conditional_power <- fail_conditional_power + 1L
      next
    }

    target_events <- ceiling(d_star)

    if (n_new_target > n) {
      n_add <- n_new_target - n

      if (is.function(event_generator_control)) {
        add_event_time1 <- event_generator_control(n_add/2)
      } else {
        add_event_time1 <- rweibull_piecewise(
          n          = n_add/2,
          shape_pre  = c_shape_pre,
          scale_pre  = c_scale_pre,
          shape_post = c_shape_post,
          scale_post = c_scale_post,
          c          = change1
        )
      }

      if (is.function(event_generator_treatment)) {
        add_event_time2 <- event_generator_treatment(n_add/2)
      } else {
        add_event_time2 <- rweibull_piecewise(
          n          = n_add/2,
          shape_pre  = t_shape_pre,
          scale_pre  = t_scale_pre,
          shape_post = t_shape_post,
          scale_post = t_scale_post,
          c          = change2
        )
      }

      add_event_time   <- c(add_event_time1, add_event_time2)
      add_group        <- c(rep(1, n_add/2), rep(2, n_add/2))

      add_rec_length <- rec_length * (n_add / n)
      add_accrual_start <- max(rec_length, interim_time)
      add_accrual_end <- add_accrual_start + add_rec_length
      add_rec_time <- runif(n_add, add_accrual_start, add_accrual_end)
      add_study_time <- add_rec_time + add_event_time
      add_subj       <- (n+1):n_new_target

      add_data <- data.frame(
        study_time = add_study_time,
        event_time = add_event_time,
        rec_time   = add_rec_time,
        group      = add_group,
        subj       = add_subj
      )

      final_pool <- rbind(all_data, add_data)
      n_new      <- n_new_target
    } else {
      final_pool <- all_data
      n_new      <- n
    }

    final_data <- apply_fixed_followup(final_pool, FIXED_FOLLOWUP)


i2 <- sum(final_data$cens)
tmpF <- tryCatch(
  survdiff(Surv(time, cens) ~ factor(group), data = final_data),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (is.null(tmpF)) {
  fail_final_logrank <- fail_final_logrank + 1L
  next
}
OEF <- tmpF$obs - tmpF$exp
U   <- as.numeric(OEF[2])
I   <- as.numeric(tmpF$var[1,1])
if (!is.finite(U) || !is.finite(I) || I <= I1) {
  fail_final_logrank <- fail_final_logrank + 1L
  next
}
Z3 <- U / sqrt(I)

stage2_lr <- stage2_logrank_fixed_followup(
  final_pool = final_pool,
  interim_time = interim_time,
  fixed_followup = FIXED_FOLLOWUP
)
U2 <- stage2_lr$U2
I2 <- stage2_lr$I2
if (!is.finite(U2) || !is.finite(I2) || I2 <= 0) {
  fail_final_logrank <- fail_final_logrank + 1L
  next
}
Z2 <- U2 / sqrt(I2)
Z2_gs <- -Z2

chw_gs <- w1_chw * Z1_gs + w2_chw * Z2_gs
chw <- -chw_gs

z2_critical_chw <- as.numeric(z2NC(z1 = Z1_gs, x = x_gs))

p_value <- pnorm(-chw_gs)
hypo <- as.integer(Z2_gs >= z2_critical_chw)

z2_critical_suff <- as.numeric(z2Z(
  z1 = Z1_gs, x = x_gs, n2 = pmax(i2 - i1, 1)
))
z_full_gs <- -Z3
p_value_full <- pnorm(-z_full_gs)
hypo_full <- as.integer(z_full_gs >= qnorm(1 - alpha_one_sided))

    logHR_hat <- tryCatch({
      cf <- coxph(Surv(time, cens) ~ factor(group), data = final_data)
      as.numeric(coef(cf))
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    p_final_data <- apply_fixed_followup(all_data, FIXED_FOLLOWUP)

    p_tst <- tryCatch(
      survdiff(Surv(time, cens) ~ factor(group), data = p_final_data),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(p_tst)) {
      fail_original_final_logrank <- fail_original_final_logrank + 1L
      next
    }
    p_OE <- p_tst$obs - p_tst$exp
    p_U  <- as.numeric(p_OE[2])
    p_I  <- as.numeric(p_tst$var[1,1])
    if (!is.finite(p_U) || !is.finite(p_I) || p_I <= I1) {
      fail_original_final_logrank <- fail_original_final_logrank + 1L
      next
    }
    p_Z <- p_U / sqrt(p_I)

    p_stage2_lr <- stage2_logrank_fixed_followup(
      final_pool = all_data,
      interim_time = interim_time,
      fixed_followup = FIXED_FOLLOWUP
    )
    p_U2 <- p_stage2_lr$U2
    p_I2 <- p_stage2_lr$I2
    if (!is.finite(p_U2) || !is.finite(p_I2) || p_I2 <= 0) {
      fail_original_final_logrank <- fail_original_final_logrank + 1L
      next
    }
    p_Z2 <- p_U2 / sqrt(p_I2)
    p_Z2_gs <- -p_Z2

    original_chw_z <- w1_chw * Z1_gs + w2_chw * p_Z2_gs
    original_z2_critical_chw <- as.numeric(z2NC(z1 = Z1_gs, x = x_gs))
    original_p_value <- pnorm(-original_chw_z)
    original_hypo <- as.integer(p_Z2_gs >= original_z2_critical_chw)

    original_full_z_gs <- -p_Z
    original_full_p_value <- pnorm(-original_full_z_gs)
    original_full_hypo <- as.integer(
      original_full_z_gs >= qnorm(1 - alpha_one_sided)
    )

    CP_original <- CP_no_inc

    candidate_result <- data.frame(
      n_new = n_new,
      ss    = nrow(final_data),
      p_ss  = nrow(p_final_data),

      events_initial_planned = ceiling(d),
      subjects_initial_planned = n,
      events_observed_interim = i1,
      subjects_enrolled_interim = nrow(i_data),
      pct_planned_subjects_enrolled_interim = 100 * nrow(i_data) / n,
      events_observed_final = i2,
      subjects_enrolled_final = nrow(final_data),

      hypo  = hypo,
      p_hypo = original_hypo,
      p_value = p_value,
      p_p_value = original_p_value,
      incD = incD,
      incN = incN,
      D_ratio = D_ratio,
      N_ratio = N_ratio,
      ssr_relevant = as.integer((type == "Unblinded") &&
        interim_treatment_favored && in_resize_zone),

      CP_interim = CP_no_inc,
      CP_after_SSR = CP_after_SSR,
      CP_original = CP_original,
      CP_design_assumption = CP_design_assumption,

      chw_z = chw_gs,
      z1_gs = Z1_gs,
      z2_gs = Z2_gs,
      z2_critical_chw = z2_critical_chw,
      z2_critical_suff = z2_critical_suff,
      p_value_full = p_value_full,
      hypo_full = hypo_full,

      original_chw_z = original_chw_z,
      original_z2_gs = p_Z2_gs,
      original_z2_critical_chw = original_z2_critical_chw,
      original_p_value = original_p_value,
      original_hypo = original_hypo,
      original_full_z_gs = original_full_z_gs,
      original_full_p_value = original_full_p_value,
      original_full_hypo = original_full_hypo,

      count_simu = NA_integer_,
      mst_hat_1  = mst_hat_1,
      mst_true_1 = mst_true_1,
      mst_hat_2  = mst_hat_2,
      mst_true_2 = mst_true_2,

      mst_hat_overall  = mst_hat_overall,
      mst_true_overall = mst_true_overall,

      rmst_hat_1  = rmst_hat_1,
      rmst_true_1 = rmst_true_1,
      rmst_hat_2  = rmst_hat_2,
      rmst_true_2 = rmst_true_2,

      max_interim_time_1  = max(i_data_1$time),
      mean_interim_time_1 = mean(i_data_1$time),
      max_interim_time_2  = max(i_data_2$time),
      mean_interim_time_2 = mean(i_data_2$time),

      p1 = p1_raw,
      p2 = p2_raw,

      i1 = i1,
      i2 = i2,

      d_req_init = d,
      d_target   = d_star,
      nlhr_star  = nlhr_star,
      logHR_hat  = logHR_hat,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    required_valid_vars <- c(
      "events_observed_interim",
      "subjects_enrolled_interim",
      "pct_planned_subjects_enrolled_interim",
      "events_observed_final",
      "subjects_enrolled_final",
      "mst_hat_1",
      "mst_true_1",
      "mst_hat_2",
      "mst_true_2",
      "incD",
      "D_ratio",
      "ssr_relevant",
      "incN",
      "N_ratio",
      "CP_interim",
      "CP_after_SSR",
      "original_hypo",
      "hypo",
      "original_p_value",
      "p_value",
      "p1",
      "p2",
      "d_target"
    )

    required_values <- unlist(
      candidate_result[1, required_valid_vars, drop = FALSE],
      use.names = FALSE
    )

    if (anyNA(required_values) ||
        !all(is.finite(as.numeric(required_values)))) {
      fail_saved_replicate_nonfinite <- fail_saved_replicate_nonfinite + 1L
      next
    }

    count_simu <- count_simu + 1L
    candidate_result$count_simu <- count_simu
    final_results[[count_simu]] <- candidate_result
  }

  if (count_simu == 0L) return(NULL)
  final_results <- do.call(rbind, final_results[seq_len(count_simu)])


  n_simu <- nrow(final_results)
  n_attempted_simulations <- as.integer(num_simulations)
  n_valid_simulations <- as.integer(n_simu)
  n_invalid_simulations <- as.integer(
    n_attempted_simulations - n_valid_simulations
  )


  events_initial_planned <- ceiling(d)
  subjects_initial_planned <- n
  mean_events_observed_interim <- mean(final_results$events_observed_interim, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_subjects_enrolled_interim <- mean(final_results$subjects_enrolled_interim, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_pct_planned_subjects_enrolled_interim <- mean(
    final_results$pct_planned_subjects_enrolled_interim, na.rm = TRUE
  )
  mean_events_observed_final <- mean(final_results$events_observed_final, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_subjects_enrolled_final <- mean(final_results$subjects_enrolled_final, na.rm = TRUE)

  err1 <- (final_results$mst_hat_1 - final_results$mst_true_1) /
    final_results$mst_true_1
  err2 <- (final_results$mst_hat_2 - final_results$mst_true_2) /
    final_results$mst_true_2
  mst_rel_rmse_1 <- sqrt(mean(err1^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mst_rel_rmse_2 <- sqrt(mean(err2^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mst_rel_rmse_equalW <- sqrt((mst_rel_rmse_1^2 + mst_rel_rmse_2^2) / 2)

  replicate_rmse_mst <- sqrt((err1^2 + err2^2) / 2)
  sd_rmse_mst <- sd(replicate_rmse_mst, na.rm = TRUE)

  rmst_err1 <- (final_results$rmst_hat_1 - final_results$rmst_true_1) /
    final_results$rmst_true_1
  rmst_err2 <- (final_results$rmst_hat_2 - final_results$rmst_true_2) /
    final_results$rmst_true_2

  rmst_rel_rmse_1 <- sqrt(mean(rmst_err1^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  rmst_rel_rmse_2 <- sqrt(mean(rmst_err2^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  rmst_rel_rmse_equalW <- sqrt(
    (rmst_rel_rmse_1^2 + rmst_rel_rmse_2^2) / 2
  )

  replicate_rmse_rmst <- sqrt((rmst_err1^2 + rmst_err2^2) / 2)
  sd_rmse_rmst <- sd(replicate_rmse_rmst, na.rm = TRUE)

  p_incD      <- mean(final_results$incD == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_incD     <- sd(final_results$incD, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_D_ratio <- mean(final_results$D_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_D_ratio   <- sd(final_results$D_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

  p_incN      <- mean(final_results$incN == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_incN     <- sd(final_results$incN, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_N_ratio <- mean(final_results$N_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_N_ratio   <- sd(final_results$N_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

  mean_CP_interim   <- mean(final_results$CP_interim, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_CP_interim     <- sd(final_results$CP_interim, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_CP_after_SSR <- mean(final_results$CP_after_SSR, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_CP_after_SSR   <- sd(final_results$CP_after_SSR, na.rm = TRUE)

  original_power_indicator <- as.numeric(final_results$original_hypo == 1)
  final_power_indicator    <- as.numeric(final_results$hypo == 1)
  original_power <- mean(original_power_indicator, na.rm = TRUE)
  final_power    <- mean(final_power_indicator, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_original_power <- sd(original_power_indicator, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_final_power    <- sd(final_power_indicator, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_original_p_value <- mean(final_results$original_p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_original_p_value   <- sd(final_results$original_p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_final_p_value    <- mean(final_results$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_final_p_value      <- sd(final_results$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)

  mean_p1 <- mean(final_results$p1, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_p1   <- sd(final_results$p1, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_p2 <- mean(final_results$p2, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_p2   <- sd(final_results$p2, na.rm = TRUE)


  power_gain <- final_power - original_power
  replicate_power_gain <- final_power_indicator - original_power_indicator
  sd_power_gain <- sd(replicate_power_gain, na.rm = TRUE)

  proportional_subject_increase <- mean_N_ratio - 1
  new_performance_score <- if (
    is.finite(proportional_subject_increase) &&
      abs(proportional_subject_increase) > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
  ) {
    power_gain / proportional_subject_increase
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  replicate_proportional_subject_increase <- final_results$N_ratio - 1
  replicate_power_gain_per_subject_increase <- ifelse(
    is.finite(replicate_proportional_subject_increase) &
      abs(replicate_proportional_subject_increase) > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
    replicate_power_gain / replicate_proportional_subject_increase,
    NA_real_
  )
  sd_power_gain_per_subject_increase <- sd(
```
