    replicate_power_gain_per_subject_increase,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  n_invalid_from_failure_counters <- as.integer(
    fail_interim_event_target +
      fail_interim_arm_information +
      fail_extrapolation_model +
      fail_extrapolation_prediction +
      fail_interim_logrank +
      fail_conditional_power +
      fail_ssr_target +
      fail_final_event_target +
      fail_final_logrank +
      fail_original_final_logrank +
      fail_saved_replicate_nonfinite
  )

  if (n_invalid_from_failure_counters != n_invalid_simulations) {
    stop(
      sprintf(
        paste0(
          "Simulation accounting error: attempted=%d, valid=%d, ",
          "invalid_by_difference=%d, invalid_by_failure_counters=%d."
        ),
        n_attempted_simulations,
        n_valid_simulations,
        n_invalid_simulations,
        n_invalid_from_failure_counters
      )
    )
  }

  report <- data.frame(
    type = type,
    rate1 = rate1,
    rate2 = rate2,
    c_shape_pre = c_shape_pre,
    c_shape_post = c_shape_post,
    c_scale_pre = c_scale_pre,
    c_scale_post = c_scale_post,
    t_shape_pre = t_shape_pre,
    t_shape_post = t_shape_post,
    t_scale_pre = t_scale_pre,
    t_scale_post = t_scale_post,
    change1 = change1,
    change2 = change2,

    Events_Initial_Planned = events_initial_planned,
    Subjects_Initial_Planned = subjects_initial_planned,
    Events_Observed_at_Interim = round(mean_events_observed_interim, 2),
    Subjects_Enrolled_at_Interim = round(mean_subjects_enrolled_interim, 2),
    Percent_Planned_Subjects_Enrolled_at_Interim =
      round(mean_pct_planned_subjects_enrolled_interim, 2),
    Events_Observed_at_Final_Analysis = round(mean_events_observed_final, 2),
    Subjects_Enrolled_at_Final_Analysis = round(mean_subjects_enrolled_final, 2),

    Probability_Increasing_Events = round(p_incD, 4),
    SD_Probability_Increasing_Events = round(sd_incD, 4),
    Mean_New_vs_Original_Events = round(mean_D_ratio, 4),
    SD_New_vs_Original_Events = round(sd_D_ratio, 4),

    Probability_Increasing_Subjects = round(p_incN, 4),
    SD_Probability_Increasing_Subjects = round(sd_incN, 4),
    Mean_New_vs_Original_Subjects = round(mean_N_ratio, 4),
    SD_New_vs_Original_Subjects = round(sd_N_ratio, 4),

    Conditional_Power_at_Interim = round(mean_CP_interim, 4),
    SD_Conditional_Power_at_Interim = round(sd_CP_interim, 4),
    Original_Power_CHW_No_Resize = round(original_power, 4),
    SD_Original_Power_CHW_No_Resize = round(sd_original_power, 4),
    Final_Power_CHW_After_SSR = round(final_power, 4),
    SD_Final_Power_CHW_After_SSR = round(sd_final_power, 4),
    Original_Mean_P_value_CHW = round(mean_original_p_value, 4),
    SD_Original_P_value_CHW = round(sd_original_p_value, 4),
    Final_Mean_P_value_CHW = round(mean_final_p_value, 4),
    SD_Final_P_value_CHW = round(sd_final_p_value, 4),

    Estimated_p1 = round(mean_p1, 4),
    SD_Estimated_p1 = round(sd_p1, 4),
    Estimated_p2 = round(mean_p2, 4),
    SD_Estimated_p2 = round(sd_p2, 4),
    RMSE_MST = round(mst_rel_rmse_equalW, 4),
    SD_RMSE_MST = round(sd_rmse_mst, 4),
    RMSE_RMST = round(rmst_rel_rmse_equalW, 4),
    SD_RMSE_RMST = round(sd_rmse_rmst, 4),

    New_Power_Gain_Per_Subject_Increase_Score = round(new_performance_score, 4),
    SD_Power_Gain_Per_Subject_Increase = round(sd_power_gain_per_subject_increase, 4),
    Power_Gain = round(power_gain, 4),
    SD_Power_Gain = round(sd_power_gain, 4),
    Proportional_Increase_in_Subjects = round(proportional_subject_increase, 4),
    Number_of_Valid_Simulations = n_valid_simulations,
    Number_of_Invalid_Simulations = n_invalid_simulations,
    Invalid_Interim_Event_Target = fail_interim_event_target,
    Invalid_Interim_Arm_Information = fail_interim_arm_information,
    Invalid_Extrapolation_Model = fail_extrapolation_model,
    Invalid_Extrapolation_Prediction = fail_extrapolation_prediction,
    Invalid_Interim_Logrank = fail_interim_logrank,
    Invalid_Conditional_Power = fail_conditional_power,
    Invalid_SSR_Target = fail_ssr_target,
    Invalid_Final_Event_Target = fail_final_event_target,
    Invalid_Final_Logrank = fail_final_logrank,
    Invalid_Original_Final_Logrank = fail_original_final_logrank,
    Invalid_Saved_Replicate_Nonfinite = fail_saved_replicate_nonfinite,
    rec = rec_length,

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  row.names(report) <- NULL

  return(report)
}

infer_piecewise_pattern_from_path <- function(file_path) {
  b <- basename(file_path)
  if (grepl("crossing", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("crossing")
  if (grepl("diverging", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("diverging")
  if (grepl("diminishing", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("diminishing")
  if (grepl("_PH_", b, ignore.case = TRUE) || grepl("PH", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("PH")
  if (grepl("reversed", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("reversed")
  if (grepl("H0", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("H0")
  "unspecified"
}

standardize_piecewise_weibull_export <- function(final_sav, file_path) {
  if (is.null(final_sav) || nrow(final_sav) == 0) return(final_sav)
  pat <- infer_piecewise_pattern_from_path(file_path)
  control_pars <- paste0(
    "Pre Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_pre,
    "); Post Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_post, ")"
  )
  treatment_pars <- paste0(
    "Pre Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_pre,
    "); Post Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_post, ")"
  )
  before_eff <- paste0(
    "Control Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_pre,
    ") vs Treatment Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_pre, ")"
  )
  after_eff <- paste0(
    "Control Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_post,
    ") vs Treatment Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_post, ")"
  )
  front <- data.frame(
    Type = final_sav$type,
    rate1 = final_sav$rate1,
    rate2 = final_sav$rate2,
    family = "PiecewiseWeibull",
    scenario = pat,
    control = control_pars,
    treatment = treatment_pars,
    before_effect = before_eff,
    after_effect = after_eff,
    additional = "Fixed follow-up duration = 5 years",
    target = NA_real_,
    change1 = final_sav$change1,
    change2 = final_sav$change2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  results <- final_sav[, -(1:13), drop = FALSE]
  desc <- data.frame(
    before = paste0("Before t=1: ", before_eff),
    after  = paste0("After t=1: ", after_eff),
    overall = paste0("Piecewise Weibull ", pat, " pattern; change point=1; fixed follow-up=5"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out <- cbind(front, results, desc)
  colnames(out) <- c(common_export_front_headers, result_headers[-(1:13)], common_distribution_description_headers)
  out <- out[, c(setdiff(names(out), "rec"), "rec"), drop = FALSE]
  out
}

standardize_piecewise_lognormal_export <- function(final_sav, file_path) {
  if (is.null(final_sav) || nrow(final_sav) == 0) return(final_sav)
  pat <- infer_piecewise_pattern_from_path(file_path)
  control_pars <- paste0(
    "Pre LogNormal(meanlog=", final_sav$c_shape_pre, ", sdlog=", final_sav$c_scale_pre,
    "); Post LogNormal(meanlog=", final_sav$c_shape_post, ", sdlog=", final_sav$c_scale_post, ")"
  )
  treatment_pars <- paste0(
    "Piecewise HR multipliers: pre=", final_sav$t_shape_pre,
    "; post=", final_sav$t_shape_post,
    "; applied to the same piecewise log-normal baseline"
  )
  before_eff <- paste0("Treatment HR multiplier before change=", final_sav$t_shape_pre)
  after_eff <- paste0("Treatment HR multiplier after change=", final_sav$t_shape_post)
  front <- data.frame(
    Type = final_sav$type,
    rate1 = final_sav$rate1,
    rate2 = final_sav$rate2,
    family = paste0("PiecewiseLogNormal_", pat),
    scenario = final_sav$type,
    control = control_pars,
    treatment = treatment_pars,
    before_effect = before_eff,
    after_effect = after_eff,
    additional = "Fixed follow-up duration = 5 years",
    target = NA_real_,
    change1 = final_sav$change1,
    change2 = final_sav$change2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  results <- final_sav[, -(1:13), drop = FALSE]
  desc <- data.frame(
    before = paste0("Before t=1: control log-normal baseline; ", before_eff),
    after = paste0("After t=1: control log-normal baseline; ", after_eff),
    overall = paste0("Piecewise log-normal ", pat, " pattern; exact segment-specific HRs; change point=1; fixed follow-up=5"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out <- cbind(front, results, desc)
  colnames(out) <- c(common_export_front_headers, result_headers[-(1:13)], common_distribution_description_headers)
  out <- out[, c(setdiff(names(out), "rec"), "rec"), drop = FALSE]
  out
}


save_result_file <- function(final_sav, file_path, headers, sheet_name = "Sheet 1") {

  if (nrow(final_sav) > 0) {
    final_sav <- final_sav[order(
      final_sav$type,
      final_sav$rate1, final_sav$rate2,
      final_sav$c_shape_pre,  final_sav$c_shape_post,
      final_sav$c_scale_pre,  final_sav$c_scale_post,
      final_sav$t_shape_pre,  final_sav$t_shape_post,
      final_sav$t_scale_pre,  final_sav$t_scale_post
    ), ]

    final_sav <- standardize_piecewise_weibull_export(final_sav, file_path)
  }

  wb <- if (file.exists(file_path)) loadWorkbook(file_path) else createWorkbook()

  if (!(sheet_name %in% names(wb))) {
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  }

  if (sheet_name %in% names(wb)) {
    removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  }

  if (nrow(final_sav) > 0) {
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = final_sav)
  }

  saveWorkbook(wb, file = file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Excel file saved to:", file_path, "\n")
}

# Run piecewise Weibull scenarios
run_scenario_family <- function(extrap_dist, scenario, scenario_seed,
                                num_simulations = 1000, checkpoint_file = NULL) {
  final_sav <- data.frame()
  if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)
  set.seed(scenario_seed)

  h1_effect_pre <- list(
    crossing = draw_uniform_range(12, 0.03, 0.06, 12011, decreasing = TRUE),
    diverging = draw_uniform_range(12, 0.14, 0.25, 12012),
    PH = draw_uniform_range(12, 0.65, 1.15, 12013, decreasing = TRUE),
    diminishing = draw_uniform_range(12, 1.0, 1.35, 12014)
  )
  h1_effect_post <- list(
    crossing = draw_uniform_range(12, 0.3, 0.75, 12021),
    diverging = draw_uniform_range(12, 0.5, 0.95, 12022),
    PH = h1_effect_pre$PH,
    diminishing = draw_uniform_range(12, 0.65, 0.95, 12024, decreasing = TRUE)
  )

  ph_common_hr <- draw_uniform_range(
    12, 0.60, 0.72, 12031, decreasing = TRUE
  )
  scenario_index <- 0L
  grid_index <- 0L

  for (sp1 in seq(0.8, 1.2, by = 0.2)) {
    for (sp2 in seq(sp1 - 0.3, sp1 - 0.1, by = 0.2)) {
      for (s1 in seq(3, 5, by = 2)) {
        for (s2 in (s1 + 4)) {
          grid_index <- grid_index + 1L

          if (scenario == "H0") {
            pars <- list(
              c_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.18,
              c_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              c_scale_pre = s1 + 3,
              c_scale_post = s2,
              t_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.18,
              t_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              t_scale_pre = s1 + 3,
              t_scale_post = s2
            )
          } else if (scenario == "H0_reversed") {
            pars <- list(
              c_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.18,
              c_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              c_scale_pre = s1 + 3,
              c_scale_post = s2,
              t_shape_pre = (sp1 - 0.18) * 0.97,
              t_shape_post = (sp2 * 0.8) * 0.95,
              t_scale_pre = (s1 + 3) * 0.88,
              t_scale_post = s2 * 0.8
            )
          } else if (scenario == "crossing") {
            pars <- list(
              c_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.18,
              c_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              c_scale_pre = s1 + 3,
              c_scale_post = s1,
              t_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.2,
              t_shape_post = sp2 * 1.05,
              t_scale_pre = s1 + 2.8,
              t_scale_post = s2 + 7
            )
          } else if (scenario == "diverging") {
            pars <- list(
              c_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.18,
              c_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              c_scale_pre = s1 + 3,
              c_scale_post = s1,
              t_shape_pre  = sp1 - 0.17,
              t_shape_post = sp2,
              t_scale_pre  = s1 + 3.8,
              t_scale_post = s2 + 4
            )
          } else if (scenario == "PH") {
            pars <- list(
              c_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.18,
              c_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              c_scale_pre = s1 + 3,
              c_scale_post = s1,
              t_shape_pre = sp1 - 0.18,
              t_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              t_scale_pre = s1 + 3,
              t_scale_post = s1
            )
          } else if (scenario == "diminishing") {
            pars <- list(
              c_shape_pre  = sp1 - 0.18,
              c_shape_post = sp2 * 0.8,
              c_scale_pre  = s1 + 3,
              c_scale_post = s1,

              t_shape_pre  = sp1 - 0.15,
              t_shape_post = sp2 * 0.81,
              t_scale_pre  = s1 + 10.2,
              t_scale_post = s1 + 6.6
            )
          } else {
            stop("Unknown scenario: ", scenario)
          }

          if (scenario %in% c("crossing", "diverging", "PH", "diminishing")) {
            scenario_index <- scenario_index + 1L

            if (scenario == "PH") {
              hr_ph <- ph_common_hr[scenario_index]^1.38
              pars$t_shape_pre  <- pars$c_shape_pre
              pars$t_shape_post <- pars$c_shape_post
              pars$t_scale_pre  <- pars$c_scale_pre / hr_ph^(1 / pars$c_shape_pre)
              pars$t_scale_post <- pars$c_scale_post / hr_ph^(1 / pars$c_shape_post)
            } else {
              f_pre  <- h1_effect_pre[[scenario]][scenario_index]
              f_post <- h1_effect_post[[scenario]][scenario_index]

              if (scenario %in% c("crossing", "diverging")) {
                f_pre  <- 1.1 * f_pre
                f_post <- 1.1 * f_post
              }

              if (scenario %in% c("crossing", "diverging")) {
                f_pre  <- 0.55 * f_pre
                f_post <- 1.55 * f_post
              } else if (scenario == "diminishing") {
                f_pre  <- 1.45 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.55 * f_post
              }

              if (scenario == "crossing") {
                f_pre  <- 0.95 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.65 * f_post
              } else if (scenario == "diverging") {
                f_pre  <- 0.85 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.85 * f_post
              }

              if (scenario == "diverging") {
                f_pre  <- 0.8 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.8 * f_post
              }

              if (scenario == "crossing") {
                f_pre  <- 1.08 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.92 * f_post
              } else if (scenario == "diverging") {
                f_pre  <- 1.12 * f_pre
                f_post <- 1.18 * f_post
              } else if (scenario == "diminishing") {
                f_pre  <- 0.86 * f_pre
                f_post <- 1.20 * f_post
              }

              if (scenario == "crossing") {
                .pw_cross_pre  <- seq(0.34, 0.46, length.out = 12)[scenario_index]
                .pw_cross_post <- seq(0.72, 0.88, length.out = 12)[scenario_index]
                f_pre  <- .pw_cross_pre
                f_post <- .pw_cross_post
              } else if (scenario == "diverging") {
                .pw_div_pre  <- seq(0.16, 0.24, length.out = 12)[scenario_index]
                .pw_div_post <- seq(0.42, 0.58, length.out = 12)[scenario_index]
                f_pre  <- .pw_div_pre
                f_post <- .pw_div_post
              }

              if (scenario == "crossing") {
                f_pre  <- 0.80 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.80 * f_post
              } else if (scenario == "diverging") {
                .pw_div_mid_pre  <- 0.205
                .pw_div_mid_post <- 0.505
                f_pre  <- .pw_div_mid_pre  + 0.30 * (f_pre  - .pw_div_mid_pre)
                f_post <- .pw_div_mid_post + 0.30 * (f_post - .pw_div_mid_post)
              }

              if (scenario == "crossing") {
                f_pre  <- 0.76 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.80 * f_post
              } else if (scenario == "diverging") {
                .pw_div_mid_pre2  <- 0.205
                .pw_div_mid_post2 <- 0.505
                f_pre  <- .pw_div_mid_pre2  + 0.12 * (f_pre  - .pw_div_mid_pre2)
                f_post <- .pw_div_mid_post2 + 0.12 * (f_post - .pw_div_mid_post2)
              }

              if (scenario == "crossing") {
                f_pre  <- 0.88 * f_pre
                f_post <- 0.92 * f_post
              } else if (scenario == "diverging") {
                f_pre  <- 1.10 * f_pre
                f_post <- 1.16 * f_post
              }

              pars$t_shape_pre <- pars$c_shape_pre +
                f_pre * (pars$t_shape_pre - pars$c_shape_pre)
              pars$t_shape_post <- pars$c_shape_post +
                f_post * (pars$t_shape_post - pars$c_shape_post)
              pars$t_scale_pre <- pars$c_scale_pre +
                f_pre * (pars$t_scale_pre - pars$c_scale_pre)
              pars$t_scale_post <- pars$c_scale_post +
                f_post * (pars$t_scale_post - pars$c_scale_post)
            }
          }

          if (grid_index %% 2L == 0L) next

          if (scenario %in% c("crossing", "diverging")) {
            .pw_retained_index <- (grid_index + 1L) %/% 2L
            .pw_rec_values <- seq(3.5, 5.5, by = 1)

            .pw_rec_results <- lapply(seq_along(.pw_rec_values), function(.pw_rec_index) {
              .pw_output_row <- (.pw_retained_index - 1L) * 3L + .pw_rec_index
              .pw_pars <- pars

              if (.pw_output_row <= 10L) {
                .pw_f_pre  <- 1.24
                .pw_f_post <- 1.36
              } else if (.pw_output_row >= 16L) {
                .pw_f_pre  <- 0.88
                .pw_f_post <- 0.92
              } else {
                .pw_f_pre  <- 1.00
                .pw_f_post <- 1.00
              }

              .pw_pars$t_shape_pre <- .pw_pars$c_shape_pre +
                .pw_f_pre * (.pw_pars$t_shape_pre - .pw_pars$c_shape_pre)
              .pw_pars$t_shape_post <- .pw_pars$c_shape_post +
                .pw_f_post * (.pw_pars$t_shape_post - .pw_pars$c_shape_post)
              .pw_pars$t_scale_pre <- .pw_pars$c_scale_pre +
                .pw_f_pre * (.pw_pars$t_scale_pre - .pw_pars$c_scale_pre)
              .pw_pars$t_scale_post <- .pw_pars$c_scale_post +
                .pw_f_post * (.pw_pars$t_scale_post - .pw_pars$c_scale_post)

              validate_piecewise_weibull_label(
                scenario, .pw_pars, change_point = 1, horizon = 5
              )

              do.call(
                simu,
                c(
                  list(
                    type = "Unblinded", alpha = 0.05, beta = 0.1,
                    rate1 = 0.6, rate2 = 0.4,
                    change1 = 1, change2 = 1,
                    rec = .pw_rec_values[.pw_rec_index], CL = 0.2, CU = 0.9,
                    num_simulations = num_simulations,
                    extrap_dist = extrap_dist
                  ),
                  .pw_pars
                )
              )
            })

            .pw_rec_results <- .pw_rec_results[
              !vapply(.pw_rec_results, is.null, logical(1))
            ]
            sav1 <- if (length(.pw_rec_results) == 0L) NULL else
              do.call(rbind, .pw_rec_results)
          } else {
            validate_piecewise_weibull_label(
              scenario, pars, change_point = 1, horizon = 5
            )

            sav1 <- do.call(
              simu,
              c(
                list(
                  type = "Unblinded", alpha = 0.05, beta = 0.1,
                  rate1 = 0.6, rate2 = 0.4,
                  change1 = 1, change2 = 1,
                  rec = seq(3.5, 5.5, by = 1), CL = 0.2, CU = 0.9,
                  num_simulations = num_simulations,
                  extrap_dist = extrap_dist
                ),
                pars
              )
            )
          }

          if (!is.null(sav1)) {
            final_sav <- rbind(final_sav, sav1)
            if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  final_sav
}

# Output settings
extrapolation_methods <- c(
  exponential = "Exponential",
  weibull = "Weibull",
  gamma = "Gamma",
  loglogistic = "LogLogistic",
  lognormal = "LogNormal"
)

scenario_definitions <- data.frame(
  scenario = c(
    "crossing", "diverging", "PH",
    "diminishing"
  ),
  seed = c(
    1234567, 2234567, 3234567,
    4234567
  ),
  file_stub = c(
    "H1_Unblinded_crossing_PiecewiseWeibull",
    "H1_Unblinded_diverging_PiecewiseWeibull",
    "H1_Unblinded_PH_PiecewiseWeibull",
    "H1_Unblinded_diminishing_PiecewiseWeibull"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

num_simulations_per_scenario <- 1000


# Generate piecewise Weibull outputs
generate_one_output <- function(task) {
  method_key <- task$method_key
  method_label <- unname(extrapolation_methods[method_key])
  j <- task$index

  final_sav <- run_scenario_family(
    extrap_dist = method_key,
    scenario = scenario_definitions$scenario[j],
    scenario_seed = scenario_definitions$seed[j],
    num_simulations = num_simulations_per_scenario,
    checkpoint_file = file.path(
      directory_path,
      paste0(scenario_definitions$file_stub[j], "_", method_label, ".xlsx")
    )
  )

  file_path <- file.path(
    directory_path,
    paste0(scenario_definitions$file_stub[j], "_", method_label, ".xlsx")
  )
  save_result_file(final_sav, file_path, result_headers)
  file_path
}

get_ssr_n_cores <- function() {
  requested <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("SSR_N_CORES", unset = NA_character_)))
  if (is.finite(requested) && requested >= 1L) return(requested)
  1L
}

run_all_outputs <- function(output_set = c("both", "piecewise_weibull", "piecewise_lognormal")) {
  output_set <- match.arg(output_set)

  dgm_groups <- if (output_set == "both") {
    c("piecewise_lognormal", "piecewise_weibull")
  } else {
    output_set
  }

  all_generated_files <- character(0)

  for (dgm_group in dgm_groups) {
    cat("\n============================================================\n")
    cat("STARTING DGM GROUP:", dgm_group, "\n")
    cat("============================================================\n")

    tasks <- list()
    kk <- 0L

    if (dgm_group == "piecewise_weibull") {
      for (method_key in names(extrapolation_methods)) {
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(scenario_definitions))) {
          kk <- kk + 1L
          tasks[[kk]] <- list(
            dgm_group = dgm_group,
            method_key = method_key,
            index = j
          )
        }
      }
    } else {
      for (method_key in names(extrapolation_methods)) {
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(piecewise_lognormal_definitions))) {
          kk <- kk + 1L
          tasks[[kk]] <- list(
            dgm_group = dgm_group,
            method_key = method_key,
            index = j
          )
        }
      }
    }

    generate_dgm_output <- function(task) {
      if (task$dgm_group == "piecewise_weibull") {
        return(generate_one_output(task))
      }

      method_key <- task$method_key
      method_label <- unname(extrapolation_methods[method_key])
      j <- task$index
      pattern <- piecewise_lognormal_definitions$pattern[j]

      final_ln <- run_piecewise_lognormal_family(
        extrap_dist = method_key,
        pattern = pattern,
        family_seed = piecewise_lognormal_definitions$seed[j],
        num_simulations = num_simulations_per_scenario,
        checkpoint_file = file.path(
          directory_path,
          paste0(
            piecewise_lognormal_definitions$file_stub[j],
            "_", method_label, ".xlsx"
          )
        )
      )

      file_path <- file.path(
        directory_path,
        paste0(
          piecewise_lognormal_definitions$file_stub[j],
          "_", method_label, ".xlsx"
        )
      )
      save_piecewise_lognormal_result_file(final_ln, file_path)
      file_path
    }

    n_cores <- min(get_ssr_n_cores(), length(tasks))
    cat("Output-level parallel workers:", n_cores, "\n")
    cat("Simulations per scenario remain:", num_simulations_per_scenario, "\n")
    cat("Number of output tasks:", length(tasks), "\n")

    if (n_cores <= 1L) {
      generated_files <- lapply(tasks, generate_dgm_output)
    } else if (.Platform$OS.type != "windows") {
      generated_files <- parallel::mclapply(
        tasks,
        generate_dgm_output,
        mc.cores = n_cores,
        mc.preschedule = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores)
      parallel::clusterExport(
        cl,
        varlist = ls(envir = .GlobalEnv),
        envir = .GlobalEnv
      )
      parallel::clusterExport(
        cl,
        varlist = c("generate_dgm_output"),
        envir = environment()
      )
      generated_files <- parallel::parLapply(cl, tasks, generate_dgm_output)
      parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    }

    generated_files <- unlist(generated_files, use.names = FALSE)
    all_generated_files <- c(all_generated_files, generated_files)

    cat("============================================================\n")
    cat("COMPLETED DGM GROUP:", dgm_group, "\n")
    cat("Number of files:", length(generated_files), "\n")
    cat("============================================================\n")
  }

  invisible(all_generated_files)
}

piecewise_lognormal_change <- 1

S_lognormal_segment <- function(t, meanlog, sdlog) {
  t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
  out <- rep(1, length(t))
  pos <- t > 0
  if (any(pos)) {
    out[pos] <- plnorm(
      t[pos], meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
  }
  pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
}

# Piecewise log-normal functions
H_lognormal_segment <- function(t, meanlog, sdlog) {
  s <- S_lognormal_segment(t, meanlog, sdlog)
  -log(pmax(s, 1e-15))
}

qH_lognormal_segment <- function(z, meanlog, sdlog) {
  z <- pmax(as.numeric(z), 0)
  p <- 1 - exp(-z)
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)
  qlnorm(p, meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog)
}

rlognormal_piecewise_hr <- function(n,
                                    meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre,
                                    meanlog_post, sdlog_post,
                                    hr_pre = 1, hr_post = 1,
                                    c = piecewise_lognormal_change) {
  if (!is.finite(hr_pre) || !is.finite(hr_post) ||
      hr_pre <= 0 || hr_post <= 0) {
    stop("hr_pre and hr_post must both be finite and > 0.")
  }

  if (c <= 0) {
    z <- rexp(n, rate = 1)
    return(qH_lognormal_segment(z / hr_post, meanlog_post, sdlog_post))
  }

  z <- rexp(n, rate = 1)
  Hc0 <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre)
  HcT <- hr_pre * Hc0
  out <- numeric(n)

  before <- z <= HcT
  if (any(before)) {
    out[before] <- qH_lognormal_segment(
      z[before] / hr_pre,
      meanlog = meanlog_pre, sdlog = sdlog_pre
    )
  }
  if (any(!before)) {
    out[!before] <- c + qH_lognormal_segment(
      (z[!before] - HcT) / hr_post,
      meanlog = meanlog_post, sdlog = sdlog_post
    )
  }
  out
}

S_lognormal_piecewise_hr <- function(t,
                                     meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre,
                                     meanlog_post, sdlog_post,
                                     hr_pre = 1, hr_post = 1,
                                     c = piecewise_lognormal_change) {
  if (!is.finite(hr_pre) || !is.finite(hr_post) ||
      hr_pre <= 0 || hr_post <= 0) {
    stop("hr_pre and hr_post must both be finite and > 0.")
  }

  t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
  H <- numeric(length(t))
  pre <- t <= c
  Hc0 <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre)

  if (any(pre)) {
    H[pre] <- hr_pre * H_lognormal_segment(
      t[pre], meanlog = meanlog_pre, sdlog = sdlog_pre
    )
  }
  if (any(!pre)) {
    H[!pre] <- hr_pre * Hc0 +
      hr_post * H_lognormal_segment(
        t[!pre] - c, meanlog = meanlog_post, sdlog = sdlog_post
      )
  }

  out <- exp(-H)
  out[t == 0] <- 1
  pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
}

piecewise_lognormal_baseline <- expand.grid(
  control_pre_median  = c(2.2, 2.8, 3.4),
  control_pre_sdlog   = c(0.6, 0.8),
  control_post_median = c(1.5, 2.5),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
piecewise_lognormal_baseline$control_post_sdlog <- 0.7
piecewise_lognormal_baseline <- piecewise_lognormal_baseline[c(1,3,5,8,10,12), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(piecewise_lognormal_baseline) <- NULL
piecewise_lognormal_baseline$baseline_id <- seq_len(nrow(piecewise_lognormal_baseline))

piecewise_lognormal_effects <- list(
  crossing    = c(hr_pre = 1.45, hr_post = 0.48),
  diverging   = c(hr_pre = 0.93, hr_post = 0.48),
  PH          = c(hr_pre = 0.6, hr_post = 0.6),
  diminishing = c(hr_pre = 0.3, hr_post = 0.78)
)

validate_piecewise_lognormal_hr_pattern <- function(pattern, hr_pre, hr_post,
                                                    tol = 1e-12) {
  ok <- switch(
    pattern,
    crossing = (hr_pre > 1 && hr_post < 1),
    diverging = (hr_pre > 0 && hr_post > 0 && hr_post < hr_pre && hr_pre < 1),
    PH = (hr_pre > 0 && hr_pre < 1 && abs(hr_pre - hr_post) <= tol),
    diminishing = (hr_pre > 0 && hr_post > 0 && hr_pre < hr_post && hr_post < 1),
    FALSE
  )
  if (!isTRUE(ok)) {
    stop(
      "Piecewise log-normal pattern validation failed for ", pattern,
      ": HR_pre=", hr_pre, ", HR_post=", hr_post
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

validate_piecewise_lognormal_crossing <- function(tab, horizon = 10) {
  grid <- seq(piecewise_lognormal_change, horizon, length.out = 5001)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    c_mp <- tab$c_meanlog_pre[i]
    c_sp <- tab$c_sdlog_pre[i]
    c_mq <- tab$c_meanlog_post[i]
    c_sq <- tab$c_sdlog_post[i]
    hp <- tab$hr_pre[i]
    hq <- tab$hr_post[i]

    Sc <- S_lognormal_piecewise_hr(
      grid, c_mp, c_sp, c_mq, c_sq,
      hr_pre = 1, hr_post = 1
    )
    St <- S_lognormal_piecewise_hr(
      grid, c_mp, c_sp, c_mq, c_sq,
      hr_pre = hp, hr_post = hq
    )
    dS <- St - Sc

    has_negative <- any(dS[grid <= piecewise_lognormal_change + 0.05] < -1e-10)
    has_positive_late <- any(dS[grid > piecewise_lognormal_change + 0.05] > 1e-10)
    if (!(has_negative && has_positive_late)) {
      stop(
        "Crossing survival validation failed for baseline scenario ",
        tab$scenario_id[i], "."
      )
    }
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

make_piecewise_lognormal_scenarios <- function(pattern) {
  if (!pattern %in% names(piecewise_lognormal_effects)) {
    stop("Unknown piecewise log-normal pattern: ", pattern)
  }

  eff <- piecewise_lognormal_effects[[pattern]]
  hp <- unname(eff["hr_pre"])
  hq <- unname(eff["hr_post"])
  validate_piecewise_lognormal_hr_pattern(pattern, hp, hq)

  rec_values <- c(3.5, 4.5, 5.5)
  n_base <- nrow(piecewise_lognormal_baseline)

  tab <- piecewise_lognormal_baseline[
    rep(seq_len(n_base), each = length(rec_values)),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  rownames(tab) <- NULL
  tab$rec <- rep(rec_values, times = n_base)
  tab$scenario_id <- seq_len(nrow(tab))

  tab$pattern <- pattern
  tab$c_meanlog_pre  <- log(tab$control_pre_median)
  tab$c_sdlog_pre    <- tab$control_pre_sdlog
  tab$c_meanlog_post <- log(tab$control_post_median)
  tab$c_sdlog_post   <- tab$control_post_sdlog

  profile_target_power <- seq(0.62, 0.86, length.out = n_base)
  profile_effect_strength <- seq(0.72, 1.02, length.out = n_base)
  tab$target_power <- rep(profile_target_power, each = length(rec_values))
  tab$effect_strength <- rep(profile_effect_strength, each = length(rec_values))
  tab$hr_pre  <- 1 + tab$effect_strength * (hp - 1)
  tab$hr_post <- 1 + tab$effect_strength * (hq - 1)

  if (identical(pattern, "diverging")) {
    tab$target_power <- pmax(0, tab$target_power - 0.15)
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^0.85
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^0.85
  } else if (identical(pattern, "diminishing")) {
    tab$target_power <- pmin(1, tab$target_power + 0.25)
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.25
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.25

    tab$target_power <- pmin(1, tab$target_power + 0.2)
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.2
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.2
  }

  if (identical(pattern, "crossing")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- 1 + 0.88 * (tab$hr_pre  - 1)
    tab$hr_post <- 1 + 0.82 * (tab$hr_post - 1)
  } else if (identical(pattern, "diverging")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^0.95
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^0.90
  } else if (identical(pattern, "PH")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^0.82
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^0.82
  } else if (identical(pattern, "diminishing")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^0.72
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^0.92
  }
  tab$target_power <- pmin(0.88, pmax(0.62, tab$target_power))

  if (identical(pattern, "crossing")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.04
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.18
  } else if (identical(pattern, "diverging")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.03
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.18
  } else if (identical(pattern, "PH")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.08
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.08
  } else if (identical(pattern, "diminishing")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.14
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.03
  }
  if (identical(pattern, "PH")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.24
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.24
  } else if (identical(pattern, "diminishing")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.20
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.12
  }

  if (identical(pattern, "diminishing")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.20
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.10
  }

  if (identical(pattern, "diminishing")) {
    tab$hr_pre  <- tab$hr_pre^1.10
    tab$hr_post <- tab$hr_post^1.05
  }

  .nprof <- length(unique(tab$control_pre_median))
  .narrow_target <- seq(0.66, 0.82, length.out = .nprof)
  tab$target_power <- rep(.narrow_target, each = length(rec_values))
  rm(.nprof, .narrow_target)

  tab$change_control <- piecewise_lognormal_change
  tab$change_treatment <- piecewise_lognormal_change

  for (.ii in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    validate_piecewise_lognormal_hr_pattern(
      pattern, tab$hr_pre[.ii], tab$hr_post[.ii]
    )
  }

  if (identical(pattern, "crossing")) {
    validate_piecewise_lognormal_crossing(tab)
  }

  if (nrow(tab) != 18L ||
      !identical(sort(unique(tab$rec)), c(3.5, 4.5, 5.5))) {
    stop("Piecewise log-normal scenario expansion failed: expected 18 rows with each of rec = 3.5, 4.5, 5.5 represented.")
  }

  tab
}

piecewise_lognormal_headers <- c(
  "Type",
  "Control Rate Assumption", "Treatment Rate Assumption",
  "Control Meanlog (Pre)", "Control Meanlog (Post)",
  "Control SDlog (Pre)", "Control SDlog (Post)",
  "Treatment HR Multiplier (Pre)", "Treatment HR Multiplier (Post)",
  "Treatment Parameter 3 (Unused)", "Treatment Parameter 4 (Unused)",
  "Control Change Point", "Treatment Change Point",
  result_headers[-(1:13)]
)

save_piecewise_lognormal_result_file <- function(final_sav, file_path,
                                                 sheet_name = "Sheet 1") {
  if (nrow(final_sav) > 0) {
    final_sav <- final_sav[order(
      final_sav$type,
      final_sav$c_shape_pre, final_sav$c_shape_post,
      final_sav$c_scale_pre, final_sav$c_scale_post,
      final_sav$t_shape_pre, final_sav$t_shape_post,
      na.last = TRUE
    ), , drop = FALSE]

    final_sav <- standardize_piecewise_lognormal_export(final_sav, file_path)
  }

  wb <- if (file.exists(file_path)) loadWorkbook(file_path) else createWorkbook()
  if (sheet_name %in% names(wb)) removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  if (nrow(final_sav) > 0) writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = final_sav)
  saveWorkbook(wb, file = file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Piecewise log-normal Excel file saved to:", file_path, "\n")
}

check_piecewise_lognormal_original_power <- function(final_sav, pattern) {
  if (is.null(final_sav) || nrow(final_sav) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  nm <- "Original_Power_CHW_No_Resize"
  if (!nm %in% names(final_sav)) return(invisible(NULL))

  p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(final_sav[[nm]]))
  bad <- is.finite(p) & (p < 0.6 | p >= 0.9)
  if (any(bad)) {
    warning(
      "Observed CHW original power outside requested [0.60, 0.90) for ", pattern,
      " in ", sum(bad), " row(s). With only ", num_simulations_per_scenario,
      " simulations per scenario, increase num_simulations_per_scenario before ",
      "treating this as a calibration failure."
    )
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Run piecewise log-normal scenarios
run_piecewise_lognormal_family <- function(extrap_dist, pattern, family_seed,
                                           num_simulations = 1000, checkpoint_file = NULL) {
  scenario_table <- make_piecewise_lognormal_scenarios(pattern)
  final_sav <- data.frame()
  if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_piecewise_lognormal_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file)

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(scenario_table))) {
    set.seed(family_seed + j - 1L)
    row <- scenario_table[j, , drop = FALSE]

    c_mp <- row$c_meanlog_pre[[1]]
    c_sp <- row$c_sdlog_pre[[1]]
    c_mq <- row$c_meanlog_post[[1]]
    c_sq <- row$c_sdlog_post[[1]]
    hp   <- row$hr_pre[[1]]
    hq   <- row$hr_post[[1]]
    rec_i <- row$rec[[1]]
    cpt  <- piecewise_lognormal_change

    gen_c <- function(n) rlognormal_piecewise_hr(
      n, c_mp, c_sp, c_mq, c_sq,
      hr_pre = 1, hr_post = 1, c = cpt
    )
    gen_t <- function(n) rlognormal_piecewise_hr(
      n, c_mp, c_sp, c_mq, c_sq,
      hr_pre = hp, hr_post = hq, c = cpt
    )
    S_c <- function(t) S_lognormal_piecewise_hr(
      t, c_mp, c_sp, c_mq, c_sq,
      hr_pre = 1, hr_post = 1, c = cpt
    )
    S_t <- function(t) S_lognormal_piecewise_hr(
      t, c_mp, c_sp, c_mq, c_sq,
      hr_pre = hp, hr_post = hq, c = cpt
    )

    sav1 <- simu(
      type = "Unblinded",
      alpha = 0.05, beta = 0.1,
      rate1 = 0.6, rate2 = 0.4,
      c_shape_pre = NA_real_, c_shape_post = NA_real_,
      c_scale_pre = NA_real_, c_scale_post = NA_real_,
      t_shape_pre = NA_real_, t_shape_post = NA_real_,
      t_scale_pre = NA_real_, t_scale_post = NA_real_,
      change1 = cpt, change2 = cpt,
      rec = rec_i, CL = 0.2, CU = 0.9,
      num_simulations = num_simulations,
      extrap_dist = extrap_dist,
      event_generator_control = gen_c,
      event_generator_treatment = gen_t,
      S_control_override = S_c,
      S_treatment_override = S_t
    )

    if (!is.null(sav1) && nrow(sav1) > 0) {
      sav1$type <- paste0("PiecewiseLogNormal_", pattern, "_", sprintf("%02d", j))
      sav1$rate1 <- 0.6
      sav1$rate2 <- 0.4
      sav1$c_shape_pre  <- c_mp
      sav1$c_shape_post <- c_mq
      sav1$c_scale_pre  <- c_sp
      sav1$c_scale_post <- c_sq
      sav1$t_shape_pre  <- hp
      sav1$t_shape_post <- hq
      sav1$t_scale_pre  <- NA_real_
      sav1$t_scale_post <- NA_real_
      sav1$change1 <- cpt
      sav1$change2 <- cpt
      final_sav <- rbind(final_sav, sav1)
      if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_piecewise_lognormal_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file)
    }
  }

  check_piecewise_lognormal_original_power(final_sav, pattern)
  final_sav
}

piecewise_lognormal_definitions <- data.frame(
  pattern = c("crossing", "diverging", "PH", "diminishing"),
  seed = c(15234567L, 16234567L, 17234567L, 18234567L),
  file_stub = c(
    "H1_Unblinded_crossing_PiecewiseLogNormal",
    "H1_Unblinded_diverging_PiecewiseLogNormal",
    "H1_Unblinded_PH_PiecewiseLogNormal",
    "H1_Unblinded_diminishing_PiecewiseLogNormal"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Generate piecewise log-normal outputs
run_all_piecewise_lognormal_outputs <- function() {
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("STARTING PIECEWISE LOG-NORMAL OUTPUT GENERATION (c = 1)\n")
  cat("Exact HR-pattern validation is ON.\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  generated_files <- character(0)
  for (method_key in names(extrapolation_methods)) {
    method_label <- unname(extrapolation_methods[method_key])

    for (j in seq_len(nrow(piecewise_lognormal_definitions))) {
      pattern <- piecewise_lognormal_definitions$pattern[j]
      final_ln <- run_piecewise_lognormal_family(
        extrap_dist = method_key,
        pattern = pattern,
        family_seed = piecewise_lognormal_definitions$seed[j],
        num_simulations = num_simulations_per_scenario,
        checkpoint_file = file.path(
          directory_path,
          paste0(piecewise_lognormal_definitions$file_stub[j], "_", method_label, ".xlsx")
        )
      )

      file_path <- file.path(
        directory_path,
        paste0(piecewise_lognormal_definitions$file_stub[j], "_", method_label, ".xlsx")
      )
      save_piecewise_lognormal_result_file(final_ln, file_path)
      generated_files <- c(generated_files, file_path)
    }
  }

  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("ALL PIECEWISE LOG-NORMAL OUTPUTS GENERATED\n")
  cat("Number of added files:", length(generated_files), "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  invisible(generated_files)
}


run_all_outputs(output_set = "both")
